approach_en: The words after the semicolon explain the blank: the elements "are joined together into a single cohesive unit". The missing word must mean "joined to one another".
approach_zh: 分号后面的话解释了空格处的词：这些组成部分“连接成一个紧密的整体”。空格处的词必须表示“彼此相连”。

approach_en: The last sentence says what each animal gets: the bird gets a meal, and the crocodile gets harmful bacteria removed. Both sides gain. The missing word must describe a relationship in which each gives something to the other.
approach_zh: 最后一句说明了双方各得到什么：鸟得到一顿饭，鳄鱼嘴里的有害细菌被清除。双方都受益。空格处的词必须形容一种彼此都有所给予的关系。

approach_en: The underlined sentence is the last one: "Bitter's feet were singing the news." Look at the sentence just before it: Jam hears a "low song" in the floorboards, "and that was how Jam knew the painting was done". The underlined sentence says the same thing again in a vivid image: the footsteps tell Jam the news.
approach_zh: 画线句是最后一句：“Bitter 的双脚在唱着这个消息。”看它前面的那一句：Jam 听到地板传来“低低的歌声”，“她就是这样知道画完成了的”。画线句用一个生动的形象把同一个意思又说了一遍：脚步声把消息告诉了 Jam。

approach_en: Follow the direction of the passage. Sentence 1 reports a study's conclusion. "However" then raises a weakness: only about 15 fish on average. Sentences 3 and 4 explain why that matters: small samples can lead to biased analysis and exaggerated effects. The whole passage raises a doubt about one study's findings.
approach_zh: 顺着文章的走向看。第1句转述了一项研究的结论。接着 However 指出了一个弱点：平均只用了大约15条鱼。第3、4句解释了这为什么重要：样本太小容易导致分析出现偏差，使效应被夸大。整段文字是在对一项研究的结论提出疑虑。

approach_en: The passage runs from a question (how do fish navigate?) through an experiment (goldfish driving a tank on wheels) to a conclusion in the last sentence: their navigation skills are not limited to water. The main idea must include that conclusion.
approach_zh: 文章的脉络是：提出问题（鱼是怎样辨别方向的）、描述实验（金鱼驾驶带轮子的鱼缸）、在最后一句给出结论：它们的导航能力并不局限于水中。主旨必须包含这个结论。

approach_en: The sentence sets a condition: "discovered before 2000". Look only at the "Year of discovery" column: Carrick-on-Suir 2013, Ardagh 1868, Balline 1940. The right choice must name hoards found before 2000 and give their years correctly.
approach_zh: 句子给出了条件：“在2000年之前被发现”。只需看“Year of discovery”（发现年份）一栏：Carrick-on-Suir 是2013年，Ardagh 是1868年，Balline 是1940年。正确选项必须举出2000年之前发现的窖藏，并且年份要与表格一致。

approach_en: The claim is the last sentence: olms "regularly come to the surface" to do important things "such as finding food". Evidence for it would be a sign that olms get food from the surface.
approach_zh: 要支持的说法是最后一句：洞螈“经常到地表来”进行“觅食之类”的重要活动。能支持它的证据，就是洞螈从地表获取食物的迹象。

approach_en: First settle who is who: creeping dogwood (C. canadensis) is the native plant, and common knotgrass (P. aviculare) is the invasive one. The conclusion is that invasive plants gain more than natives when freezing weather comes later in autumn. Support would be a result in which the invasive plant benefits more than the native one in late-freeze years.
approach_zh: 先分清两种植物：creeping dogwood（C. canadensis）是本地植物，common knotgrass（P. aviculare）是入侵植物。结论是：秋季冰冻来得越晚，入侵植物得到的好处比本地植物更多。能支持它的，是在晚冻年份入侵植物比本地植物获益更多的结果。

approach_en: The finding to explain is that people recruited by someone they know stayed in the study much more often than people recruited by strangers. The only difference between the groups is the social tie to the recruiter. The conclusion must say what that tie might do: make people feel they should keep going.
approach_zh: 需要解释的发现是：由熟人招募来的参与者，留在研究中的比例远高于由陌生人招募来的参与者。两组之间唯一的差别是与招募者之间有没有社会关系。结论必须说明这种关系可能起了什么作用：让人觉得自己应该坚持下去。

approach_en: The sentence gives a fact that is always true: a xenon atom has 54 protons. General facts take the simple present tense, and the sentences around it ("indicates", "explains") are in the present too.
approach_zh: 这句话陈述的是一个永远成立的事实：氙原子有54个质子。一般事实用一般现在时，前后的句子（indicates、explains）也都是现在时。

approach_en: Find the subject of the missing verb. It is "more writers from Chad", which is plural. "Including Lamko", between commas, is extra and does not change the subject. A plural subject takes a plural verb.
approach_zh: 找出空格处动词的主语：是“more writers from Chad”，复数。两个逗号之间的“including Lamko”是插入的补充成分，不改变主语。复数主语要用复数形式的动词。

approach_en: The main sentence is already complete: "it is one of over 1,000 such world maps ...". What follows is an added phrase that starts with "with": "with the ... Hereford map ... being another one". After "with + noun", English uses an "-ing" form, not a full verb.
approach_zh: 主句已经完整：“it is one of over 1,000 such world maps ...”。后面是 with 引出的附加成分：“with the ... Hereford map ... being another one”。在“with + 名词”之后，英语用动词的 -ing 形式，而不用完整的谓语动词。

approach_en: "With over two millennia of climate data in its tree rings" is an introductory phrase, not a sentence: it has no subject and verb. The main sentence is "a single tree like this ... can tell the history of the world". An introductory phrase is followed by a comma.
approach_zh: “With over two millennia of climate data in its tree rings”是句首的介词短语，没有主语和谓语，不是完整的句子。主句是“a single tree like this ... can tell the history of the world”。句首短语后面用逗号。

approach_en: "The fashion designers" does not tell the reader who they are, so the two names are needed to identify them and take no commas. The names are also the subject of "developed", and a subject is not separated from its verb by a comma.
approach_zh: “the fashion designers”本身没有说明是谁，必须靠两个人名来确定，所以人名是必不可少的，前后不加逗号。此外，这两个人名是 developed 的主语，主语和谓语之间也不能用逗号隔开。

approach_en: The researchers expected one thing: that the spiders spread fast because they are aggressive. They found the opposite: the spiders are "gentle giants" that freeze when disturbed. What was found replaces what was expected, and "instead" marks that.
approach_zh: 研究者原本的猜测是：这种蜘蛛扩散得快，是因为它们有攻击性。他们发现的情况正好相反：这种蜘蛛是“温和的大个子”，受到惊扰就一动不动。实际的发现取代了原先的猜测，用 instead 来表示。

approach_en: The first sentence gives what some bands do: pick the most unusual name possible. The second says Primary "took a different approach". The words "a different approach" already announce a contrast, so the transition must mark contrast.
approach_zh: 第一句讲的是一些乐队的做法：尽量取一个独一无二的名字。第二句说 Primary 乐队“走了另一条路”。“a different approach”本身就已经表明这是对比，所以过渡词必须表示对比。

approach_en: The first sentence states a fact: the Eloi are fictional creatures. The second states what follows from that fact: they were ideal for a book of imaginary beings. The link is "because they are that kind of thing", which is what "as such" expresses.
approach_zh: 第一句陈述了一个事实：Eloi 是虚构的生物。第二句说的是由这个事实得出的结果：它们非常适合收进一本讲想象中的生物的书。两句之间的关系是“正因为它们是这样的东西”，这正是“as such”所表达的意思。

approach_en: The goal is to stress the order in which the two supercontinents formed. The notes give the dates: Ur about 3.1 billion years ago, Pangaea about 300 million years ago. So Ur came first and Pangaea much later. The right choice must state which came before which.
approach_zh: 目标是强调两个超大陆形成的先后顺序。笔记给出了年代：Ur 大约形成于31亿年前，Pangaea 大约形成于3亿年前。所以 Ur 在先，Pangaea 晚得多。正确选项必须说出谁先谁后。

approach_en: The goal is to give an example of a poem by Johnson. Only one note names a poem: "Old Things" is a poem by Johnson. The right choice must name it.
approach_zh: 目标是举出 Johnson 的一首诗作为例子。只有一条笔记提到了诗的名字：《Old Things》是 Johnson 的一首诗。正确选项必须说出这首诗。

approach_en: The goal is to give an example of a position in ballroom dance. The notes name one: "closed facing position". The right choice must name it.
approach_zh: 目标是举出交谊舞中的一个舞姿作为例子。笔记里提到了一个：“closed facing position”（闭式相对位）。正确选项必须说出它。

approach_en: Richard speaks openly about his own trick. He says three things: he is the one who does wrong; he blames his secret harm on others; and he weeps for Clarence in front of gullible men, telling them the queen's side is responsible. The right choice must say both that his grief is an act and that he himself caused Clarence's trouble.
approach_zh: Richard 坦白地说出了自己的把戏。他讲了三点：做坏事的是他自己；他把自己暗中干的坏事推到别人头上；他在轻信的人面前为 Clarence 流泪，告诉他们是王后一伙人干的。正确选项必须同时说出两点：他的悲伤是装出来的，而 Clarence 的遭遇正是他造成的。

approach_en: Schober's hypothesis is that the watercourts were also meant "to foster conch", that is, to raise these sea snails. The strongest evidence against it would show that the watercourts could not have been a place where conch live well.
approach_zh: Schober 的假说是：这些水庭院还有一个用途，就是“养殖海螺”（foster conch）。最有力的反面证据，是表明这些水庭院根本不可能是海螺能良好生存的地方。

approach_en: The hypothesis says plants adjust the balance of male and female flowers during the season, and that this raises the chance of successful pollination. The researchers conclude the data do not support it. So look for data showing that the balance changed a lot while success did not improve. In the table, the proportion of male flowers falls to 0.13 on day 20, yet the success rate of male flowers stays at 0.29 on every day.
approach_zh: 假说认为：植物会在花期内调整雄花和雌花的比例，而这样做能提高成功授粉的概率。研究者的结论是数据并不支持这个假说。所以要找的数据是：比例变化很大，成功率却没有提高。表中雄花的比例到第20天降到了0.13，而雄花的繁殖成功率每一天都是0.29。

approach_en: The first sentence says Tavinor treats games as a kind of fiction and Gaut treats them as a kind of cinema, and that "neither approach adequately captures a central aspect of playing": being absorbed in the gameplay itself. Nguyen says the designer's real medium is "player agency", which gives players enjoyable experiences. "Therefore" must sum this up: the two frameworks put games into other categories that miss this feature.
approach_zh: 第一句说，Tavinor 把电脑游戏看作虚构作品的一种，Gaut 把它归入电影的范畴，而“这两种思路都没有充分把握玩游戏的一个核心方面”：玩家完全沉浸在游戏操作本身之中。Nguyen 则认为，设计者真正使用的媒介是“玩家的能动性”，它给玩家带来愉悦的体验。Therefore 之后必须对此加以总结：这两个框架把游戏归到别的类别里，而那些类别并不涉及这个特征。

approach_en: The main sentence ends at "protest". What follows, "a decision that ... amplified the agency and power the workers possessed", renames the whole action as "a decision" and comments on it, so a comma comes before it. Inside it, "by allowing the narrative to be shaped by one of their own" interrupts between "that" and "amplified", so it needs a comma on each side: one after "that" to match the one after "own".
approach_zh: 主句到 protest 结束。后面“a decision that ... amplified the agency and power the workers possessed”把前面整件事概括为“一个决定”并加以评价，是同位语，前面要用逗号。在这个同位语内部，“by allowing the narrative to be shaped by one of their own”插在 that 和 amplified 之间，前后都要有逗号：that 后面的逗号与 own 后面的逗号配成一对。

approach_en: The first sentence describes what the two writers did: they published for forty years under one shared name. The second says what this made possible: they could express a joint creative vision. The first sentence is the means and the second is what the means achieved.
approach_zh: 第一句描述了两位作家的做法：四十年里用同一个共用的名字发表作品。第二句说的是这种做法带来了什么：她们得以表达共同的创作理念。第一句是手段，第二句是这个手段实现的结果。

approach_en: The goal is to explain why nautical miles are used at sea. Build the reason from the notes: a nautical mile equals one minute of latitude; latitude and longitude take Earth's curvature into account; mariners use charts marked in latitude and longitude to work out distances quickly. So nautical miles fit the charts and make calculation quick and accurate.
approach_zh: 目标是解释为什么航海中用海里来计量距离。用笔记里的内容把理由搭起来：一海里等于纬度的一分；用经纬度计量距离考虑到了地球的曲率；航海者使用标有经纬度的海图来快速计算距离。所以，海里与海图的坐标直接对应，计算起来又快又准。

approach_en: Three findings. In undisturbed waters, dissolved organic carbon and mercury rise together. In waters affected by wastewater, they do not. Some scientists guessed the link exists only in undisturbed waters. But in waters disturbed by urban development the link appears again. So wastewater is a special case, and what it does cannot be assumed for every human disturbance.
approach_zh: 有三项发现。在未受干扰的水体中，溶解有机碳和汞的含量一同升高；在受废水影响的水体中，没有这种关系；于是有科学家猜测，这种关联只存在于未受干扰的水体中。但在受城市开发干扰的水体中，这种关联又出现了。所以废水是个特例，不能认为每一种人为干扰都会产生和它一样的影响。

approach_en: The dash explains the blank: these features are "those that result from impromptu deviations of performers" when they need not follow the score exactly. "Impromptu" means done on the spot, without preparation. The missing word must mean the same.
approach_zh: 破折号后面的话解释了空格处的词：这些特点是“演奏者在不要求严格遵照既定乐谱时即兴发挥而产生的”。impromptu 的意思是当场的、没有准备的。空格处的词必须是同样的意思。

approach_en: Take the sentences one at a time. Sentence 1 names and defines a way of doing research: community science. Sentence 2 lists its benefits. Sentence 3 mentions a study that depended on it. The structure is: an approach, its benefits, a study that used it.
approach_zh: 逐句来看。第1句提出并界定了一种研究方式：社区科学。第2句列举了它的好处。第3句提到了一项依靠它完成的研究。结构是：一种方法、它的好处、一项运用了它的研究。

approach_en: The first sentence makes a general statement: many mushroom species contain phenolic compounds, and it names two such compounds. The second gives particular cases: one compound found in one mushroom, the other in another. A general statement followed by particular cases calls for "for example".
approach_zh: 第一句作了一般性的陈述：许多种蘑菇含有酚类化合物，并举出了两种这样的化合物。第二句给出了具体的情况：在一种蘑菇里检测到其中一种化合物，在另一种蘑菇里检测到另一种。先概括、再举具体情况，要用“for example”。

approach_en: Two decisions. First: "the novelist" does not say which novelist, so the name is needed to identify her and takes no commas. Second: "author of Inheritance" is extra information about her, so a comma sets it off.
approach_zh: 要判断两处。第一，“the novelist”本身没有说明是哪一位小说家，必须靠姓名来确定，所以姓名是必不可少的，前后不加逗号。第二，“author of Inheritance”是对她的补充介绍，要用逗号隔开。

approach_en: Read the claim closely: Toomer describes Dixie Pike "as having a deep connection to a faraway place". The right quotation must mention Dixie Pike and tie it to somewhere distant.
approach_zh: 仔细读这个说法：Toomer 把 Dixie Pike 描写成“与一个遥远的地方有着很深的联系”。正确的引文必须提到 Dixie Pike，并把它和某个遥远的地方联系起来。

approach_en: The first sentence says poisonous amphibians migrate safely "during the day". The second explains what protects them in daylight: "with the sun in the sky", predators can see their warning colors. The transition should point back to the time just named, the daytime.
approach_zh: 第一句说有毒的两栖动物“在白天”安全地迁徙。第二句解释了白天是什么在保护它们：“太阳当空”，捕食者看得见它们的警戒色。过渡语应当指回刚才提到的时间，也就是白天。

approach_en: The first sentence states a general pattern: with many elements a pure sample was isolated soon after discovery. The second admits that the pattern has exceptions: "this wasn't the case with all elements". A word that admits a limit to what was just said is "granted".
approach_zh: 第一句陈述了一个普遍的规律：许多元素在被发现后不久就分离出了纯度较高的样品。第二句承认这个规律有例外：“并不是所有元素都是这样”。用来承认前面的说法有局限的词是 granted（诚然）。

approach_en: Put each choice in place of "breathes": "him whose name ___ bravery and life and courage to the tribe". The words "to the tribe" show that something passes from the name to the people. A name that gives the tribe bravery and courage "imparts" them.
approach_zh: 把每个选项代入 breathes 的位置：“他的名字把勇敢、生命和勇气 ___ 给部落”。“to the tribe”表明有东西从这个名字传到了人们那里。一个名字给部落带来勇敢和勇气，就是把它们“赋予”部落。

approach_en: The claim has two parts: (1) the methods are still used today in the Southwest, and (2) they go back long before 1890, when Searsville Lake was finished ("a lineage that long predates"). The right quotation must show something very old that is still in use.
approach_zh: 这个论断有两点：（1）这些方法今天仍在西南部使用；（2）它们的渊源远远早于1890年 Searsville Lake 建成之时（a lineage that long predates）。正确的引文必须说到某种很古老、至今仍在使用的东西。

approach_en: The word "also" ties the squash to the lima beans. The lima bean's structure "is no longer identical" to that of its wild ancestor. So squash, too, is different from its ancestor, and the next sentences show how: hard rind and bitter flesh then, soft rind and mild flesh now.
approach_zh: also 把西葫芦和利马豆联系了起来。利马豆的结构与它的野生祖先“已经不再相同”。所以西葫芦同样与它的祖先不同，后面的句子说明了怎么个不同法：从前皮硬肉苦，如今皮软味淡。

approach_en: The second sentence contrasts what was expected with what was found. Expected: "some ... of carbon". Found: the algae "reabsorb" carbon dioxide they produce and "harness it for photosynthesis", that is, use it again. The missing word must name that using again. The first sentence calls it "internal carbon recycling".
approach_zh: 第二句把预期与实际发现作了对比。预期：碳的“某种……”；发现：这种藻类把自己产生的二氧化碳“重新吸收”并“用于光合作用”，也就是再用一次。空格处的词必须指这种“再用”。第一句把它叫作“内部的碳循环利用”。

approach_en: Ask what the passage as a whole does. It names what inspired land art (the Nazca lines), says when the movement began (the 1960s), says what land artists do (make works outdoors) and gives one example (Annual Rings). Every sentence gives information about the land art movement.
approach_zh: 看整段文字做了什么。它提到了大地艺术的灵感来源（纳斯卡线条），说明了这场运动开始的时间（20世纪60年代），说明了大地艺术家做什么（在户外创作），还举了一个例子（《Annual Rings》）。每一句都在提供有关大地艺术运动的信息。

approach_en: The first two sentences describe choices Zhao makes when filming: real events, non-professional actors from the places shown, and roles that draw on the actors' own lives. The last sentence says what those choices achieve: they add force to films about "place and home". The passage links her methods to her themes.
approach_zh: 前两句描述了赵婷拍片时的选择：采用真实事件，起用住在故事发生地的非职业演员，并让演员把自己的经历融入角色。最后一句说明了这些选择带来的效果：它们让探讨“地方与家园”的影片更有感染力。这段文字是把她的方法和她的主题联系起来。

approach_en: A main topic is the subject every sentence is about. Sentence 1 defines a debut novel, sentences 2 and 3 give an example, and sentence 4 says why debut novels interest people. All four are about debut novels.
approach_zh: 主题是每一句都在谈的对象。第1句给“处女作小说”下定义，第2、3句举了一个例子，第4句说明处女作小说为什么受关注。四句话讲的都是处女作小说。

approach_en: The claim names two qualities at once: Joe is "both powerful and tender". The right quotation must show strength and gentleness together.
approach_zh: 这个说法同时提到两种品质：Joe“既有力量又很温柔”。正确的引文必须同时体现力量和温柔。

approach_en: The sentence asks about one bear, number 137. Find that row in the table and read across: sex, age, weight. Then pick the choice that copies the row exactly.
approach_zh: 句子问的是编号137的那头熊。在表格中找到这一行，依次读出性别、年龄、体重，再选出与这一行完全一致的选项。

approach_en: The underlined claim is the last sentence, and it is a doubt: participants may have succeeded partly by using "additional context" in the videos (images or sounds) and not the gestures alone. To support a doubt, find a case in which the video did give such a clue.
approach_zh: 画线的说法是最后一句，它表达的是一种疑虑：参与者之所以答对，可能部分是借助了视频中“额外的情境信息”（画面或声音），而不只是手势本身。要支持这种疑虑，就要找一个视频确实提供了这类线索的情况。

approach_en: Follow the chain of causes. Water evaporates from the crust and leaves empty spaces ("voids"). Oil fills those spaces, which raises the fat content. More water keeps moving out to the crust. So the more water leaves, the more room there is for oil, and the higher the fat content.
approach_zh: 顺着因果链往下推。外皮中的水分蒸发，留下空隙（voids）；油填进这些空隙，脂肪含量随之升高；内部的水分还在不断移向外皮。所以，水分流失得越多，留给油的空间就越大，脂肪含量也就越高。

approach_en: Find where one complete sentence ends and the next begins. "Both host detection and transportation are electrically mediated" can stand alone, and so can "when mites move their legs ..., they are pulled ...". The second statement explains the first, so a colon joins them.
approach_zh: 先找出两个完整句子的分界。“Both host detection and transportation are electrically mediated”本身是完整的句子，后面“when mites move their legs ..., they are pulled ...”也是完整的句子，而且后一句是在解释前一句，所以用冒号连接。

approach_en: The goal is to stress a difference between the two seaweeds. The notes give one difference: wakame's umami was rated moderate, ma-konbu's high. The right choice must put the two side by side on that point.
approach_zh: 目标是强调两种海藻之间的差别。笔记里给出的差别只有一个：wakame 的鲜味强度被评为中等，ma-konbu 的被评为高。正确选项必须就这一点把两者放在一起比较。

approach_en: The goal is to give a specific example of an isthmus. The notes name one: the Isthmus of Tehuantepec in Mexico. The right choice must name it and call it an isthmus.
approach_zh: 目标是举出一个具体的地峡作为例子。笔记里提到了一个：墨西哥的特万特佩克地峡（Isthmus of Tehuantepec）。正确选项必须说出它的名字，并说明它是地峡。

approach_en: The passage describes the woman as "unexpectedly reticent" about Ethan Frome and speaks of her "insurmountable reluctance to speak of him". "Her reserve" names the same thing: her holding back from speaking. The choice must mean a holding back.
approach_zh: 文中说这位女士谈到 Ethan Frome 时“出人意料地寡言”，还说她“有一种无法克服的不愿谈他的心理”。“her reserve”指的是同一件事：她克制着不肯多说。选项必须表示“克制、有所保留”。

approach_en: Find what Wade says about the first booklet: its three texts "were likely copied by Richard Heege from a traveling minstrel's repertoire book". The last sentence gives his evidence, including jokes that name the town of Radford for use in nearby Brackonwet, which places the minstrel in that area. The answer must keep both points and add nothing.
approach_zh: 找出 Wade 对第一分册的看法：其中的三篇文本“很可能是 Richard Heege 从一位游吟艺人的保留节目本上抄来的”。最后一句给出了证据，包括一些在 Brackonwet 演出时可以改成拿邻镇 Radford 开玩笑的笑话，这说明这位艺人在这一带活动。正确选项必须包含这两点，而且不能添加原文没有的内容。

approach_en: The passage contrasts two things. Studying philosophy means knowing the key texts and thinkers. Doing philosophy means using that "acquired expertise" in a creative way and treating past thinkers as "interlocutors" (partners in conversation) who help produce "new insights". The answer must show that doing builds on studying.
approach_zh: 文章对比了两件事。“学习哲学”（studying）是熟悉重要的文本和思想家；“做哲学”（doing）是创造性地运用已经学到的专门知识（acquired expertise），把过去的思想家当作对话者（interlocutors），借助他们得出新的见解（new insights）。正确选项要体现“做哲学”建立在“学习哲学”的基础之上。

approach_en: The conclusion is that South Asian spices and South Asian-style tools at Óc Eo "must" mean a trade link between the two regions. To weaken a "must", find another way the spices and tools could have arrived. If people themselves moved from South Asia, they could have brought their tools and cooking with them, with no trade needed.
approach_zh: 结论是：Óc Eo 出土的南亚香料和南亚样式的工具“必定”说明两地之间存在贸易联系。要削弱一个“必定”，就要找出香料和工具还可能通过别的途径到来。如果是南亚人自己迁了过来，他们就可以把工具和烹饪方式一起带来，不需要贸易。

approach_en: Turn each ratio into an age using the table. MFS is 0.709000, which is exactly 5.86 Ma. PFBV is 0.709028, which lies between 0.709020 (5.40 Ma) and 0.709040 (4.75 Ma), so roughly 5.1 Ma. Hh4 runs from 6 to 4.75 Ma, so both sites fall inside Hh4, and PFBV, with the smaller age, is the more recent.
approach_zh: 用表格把每个比值换算成年代。MFS 的比值是0.709000，正好对应5.86 Ma（百万年前）。PFBV 的比值是0.709028，介于0.709020（5.40 Ma）和0.709040（4.75 Ma）之间，大约是5.1 Ma。Hh4 的范围是6 Ma 到4.75 Ma，所以两处都落在 Hh4 之内；PFBV 的年代数值更小，也就是更晚近。

approach_en: The passage builds a chain: last-mile delivery is hard; the bottleneck is growing; companies are trying new solutions; "unfortunately" those solutions bring new problems and are "not ready". "As a result" must give the outcome: the difficulty continues until solutions that work appear.
approach_zh: 文章构成了一条因果链：“最后一公里”配送很困难；包裹积压越来越严重；公司正在尝试新的解决办法；“可惜”这些办法又带来新问题，“还不成熟”。“As a result”之后必须给出结果：在可行的办法出现之前，困难会持续下去。

approach_en: The blank needs a word meaning "belonging to the post": "the physical location in which a social media post was created and its contents". "A social media post" is singular, so the possessive is "its", with no apostrophe.
approach_zh: 空格处需要一个表示“这条帖子的”的词：“the physical location in which a social media post was created and its contents”（帖子发布的地点和它的内容）。“a social media post”是单数，所以用所有格 its，没有撇号。

approach_en: Three steps. Sentence 1 makes a claim: these architects celebrated nature. Sentence 2, beginning "Granted", admits a point against it: such a building could not actually grow in a forest. Sentence 3 returns to the claim: natural influences are visible all the same. After a concession, the word that brings back the main point is "still".
approach_zh: 分三步。第1句提出论点：这些建筑师在设计中推崇自然。第2句以 Granted 开头，承认一个不利于论点的事实：这样的建筑当然不可能真的长在森林里。第3句回到论点：自然的影响仍然清晰可见。让步之后，把话题拉回主要论点的词是 still（尽管如此）。

approach_en: The goal is to show how one element's emission spectrum relates to violet light. Check the numbers: violet is 380 to 450 nm. Titanium's 430.5 nm falls inside that range; krypton's 583.2 nm does not. The right choice must name an element, give its wavelength and place it correctly.
approach_zh: 目标是说明某一种元素的发射光谱与可见光谱中紫色部分的关系。核对数字：紫光的波长范围是380至450纳米。钛的430.5纳米落在这个范围内，氪的583.2纳米不在。正确选项必须点出一种元素，给出它的波长，并且归属正确。

approach_en: The Apollo missions ended in 1972, yet a researcher "continues to use Apollo's data" today. That shows the missions' value to science has not ended. The missing word must mean "goes on".
approach_zh: 阿波罗任务在1972年就结束了，而今天仍有研究者“继续使用阿波罗的数据”。这说明这些任务对科学的价值并没有终结。空格处的词必须表示“继续存在”。

approach_en: The second sentence gives three versions of the dish, each tied to a place: coastal families use seafood, mountain families use chicharrones, and chefs in San Juan try new toppings. The missing word must say that how the dish is made depends on where it is made.
approach_zh: 第二句给出了这道菜的三种做法，每一种都与一个地方相联系：沿海人家配海鲜，山区人家配炸猪皮，圣胡安的餐厅厨师尝试新的浇头。空格处的词必须表示这道菜怎么做取决于在哪里做。

approach_en: The second sentence says what these writers do for readers around the world: they bring them "the manifold experiences of the Hawaiian people". Writers who carry a people's experiences to distant readers make those experiences clear and visible. The missing word must mean "shedding light on".
approach_zh: 第二句说明了这些作家为世界各地的读者做了什么：把“夏威夷人民多种多样的经历”带给他们。把一个民族的经历传达给远方读者的作家，是让这些经历变得清晰可见。空格处的词必须表示“阐明、展现”。

approach_en: The underlined part is the opening: "People tend to assume that being happy is the ideal emotional state". Then comes "however": research suggests negative emotions can help, and in the experiment angry participants solved puzzles best. So the underlined part states a common belief that the experiment's result puts in doubt.
approach_zh: 画线部分是开头：“人们往往认为快乐是理想的情绪状态”。接着是 however：研究表明负面情绪有时有益，实验中处于愤怒状态的参与者解题成绩最好。所以画线部分陈述的是一种普遍的看法，而实验结果对这种看法提出了质疑。

approach_en: Look at how Mercedes reacts as Clarence's train leaves: she is pale, her hands tremble, her heart beats faster, and she hears the train's whistle as a cry of pain at being "torn from her", a cry she wants to make too. All of this shows her grief at the separation.
approach_zh: 看 Clarence 乘坐的火车离开时 Mercedes 的反应：脸色苍白，双手颤抖，心跳加快，她把汽笛声听成了“被迫与她分离”的痛苦呼喊，而她自己也想这样呼喊。这些都表现出她因分离而悲伤。

approach_en: Follow what Dantès does, step by step: he digs carefully, attacks the wall with a pickaxe, works for ten minutes, cuts the strongest tree he can find and uses it as a lever. Every action is another attempt to move the rock. Only one choice describes what the text actually shows.
approach_zh: 按顺序看 Dantès 做了什么：小心地挖土，用镐凿墙，干了十分钟，砍下能找到的最结实的橄榄树当撬杠。每一个动作都是为了搬开岩石而作的又一次努力。只有一个选项说的是原文实际呈现的内容。

approach_en: The underlined claim is the last sentence: the period eye "has significantly influenced the practice of art history" since it was introduced in the early 1970s. Support would be historians after that time working in the way Baxandall proposed: studying how artworks were understood in their own period.
approach_zh: 画线的说法是最后一句：“时代之眼”自20世纪70年代初提出以来，“显著影响了艺术史的研究实践”。能支持它的，是此后的艺术史学者按 Baxandall 主张的方式做研究：考察艺术品在它们自己的时代是怎样被理解的。

approach_en: Put two facts together. Fishers rely on the models to decide how much they can catch without overfishing. The models often said there were more fish than there really were. So fishers who trusted them may have caught too many without knowing it.
approach_zh: 把两个事实放在一起看。渔民依靠这些模型来决定在不造成过度捕捞的前提下可以捕多少鱼；而模型给出的鱼群数量常常高于实际数量。所以，相信模型的渔民可能在不知情的情况下捕得太多了。

approach_en: The question was whether the first appearance of microplastics in sediment could mark the start of the Anthropocene (about 1950). The result: microplastics were in every layer, even layers from the late 1700s, because they sank down through the sediment. So the deepest layer containing them does not show when they first appeared, and it cannot mark the start of the epoch.
approach_zh: 要回答的问题是：微塑料在沉积物中最早出现的位置，能不能标志人类世（大约从1950年起）的开始。结果是：所有层位都有微塑料，连18世纪晚期的层位也有，因为它们会在沉积物中向下迁移。所以，含有微塑料的最深层位并不能说明微塑料最早出现的时间，也就不能标志这个地质时代的开始。

approach_en: The passage accepts that the novel is autobiographical but warns that "much of the novel is pure invention". Readers who forget this and look only for links to the author's life miss what he invented, that is, his creativity.
approach_zh: 文章承认这部小说带有自传性，但提醒说“小说的很大一部分纯属虚构”。忘记这一点、只顾寻找小说与作者生平对应之处的读者，会看不到他虚构的部分，也就是他的创造力。

approach_en: The passage sets up a puzzle and then an answer. Linguists say the poetic quality of Eugene Onegin cannot be translated faithfully. Cranko did not try to follow the text scene by scene; he made a ballet that carries its feeling. A critic says his dance calls up exactly "the parts ... that were deemed untranslatable". So the loose ballet may have kept the essentials better than a word-for-word translation.
approach_zh: 文章先提出难题，再给出回应。语言学家说，《叶甫盖尼·奥涅金》的抒情性无法被忠实地翻译。Cranko 没有逐个场景照搬原作，而是编了一部传达其情感的芭蕾舞。一位评论家说，他的舞蹈唤起的恰恰是“被认为无法翻译的那些部分”。所以，这部自由改编的芭蕾可能比逐字的翻译更好地保留了原作的精髓。

approach_en: The subject is "emulsifiers that have been employed for millennia", plural. The time is given by "to this day", which means now. So the verb must be plural and present.
approach_zh: 主语是“emulsifiers that have been employed for millennia”，复数。时间由“to this day”（直到今天）给出，也就是现在。所以谓语要用复数、现在时。

approach_en: Check each side of the blank. "How a folktale begins depends largely on the language in which it originates" is a complete sentence. "Many folktales told in the Czech language open with a phrase ..." is another. Two complete sentences with no joining word need a period.
approach_zh: 看空格两边。“How a folktale begins depends largely on the language in which it originates”是完整的句子，“Many folktales told in the Czech language open with a phrase ...”是另一个完整的句子。两个完整的句子之间没有连词，要用句号。

approach_en: The sentence opens with a describing phrase: "Established in 1934 for the specific purpose of protecting US investors ...". Ask: what was established in 1934 for that purpose? The Securities and Exchange Commission. The thing described must come right after the comma, as the subject.
approach_zh: 句子以一个修饰短语开头：“Established in 1934 for the specific purpose of protecting US investors ...”。要问：什么是在1934年为这个目的而设立的？是证券交易委员会（SEC）。被修饰的对象必须紧跟在逗号后面作主语。

approach_en: The subject is "the word "mustang"", one word, so the verb must be singular. The second half of the same sentence gives a model: ""stockade" ... derives from estacada". The two halves should match in number and tense.
approach_zh: 主语是“the word “mustang””，是一个词，所以动词要用单数。同一句的后半部分正好提供了参照：““stockade” ... derives from estacada”。前后两个分句的数和时态应当一致。

approach_en: The long first part, up to "as rain or snow", is one complete sentence describing what water does. "This process is called the water cycle" is a second complete sentence. Two complete statements with no joining word are separated by a period.
approach_zh: 前面很长的一部分，到“as rain or snow”为止，是一个完整的句子，描述水的变化过程。“This process is called the water cycle”是第二个完整的句子。两个完整的陈述句之间没有连词，用句号隔开。

approach_en: "Many travelers recommend" tells which kind of city Odessa is, so it is essential to the meaning: use "that" with no comma. The verb "recommend" also needs a direct object (travelers recommend the city), and "that" supplies it.
approach_zh: “many travelers recommend”说明 Odessa 是什么样的城市，对句意必不可少，所以用 that 引导，前面不加逗号。另外，recommend 需要直接宾语（旅行者推荐这座城市），that 正好充当这个宾语。

approach_en: The first sentence gives an idea that is "tempting to think": both comic strips aim mainly to amuse. The second sentence corrects it: Wee Pals also aims to challenge readers with social and political comment. A transition that replaces a tempting but wrong idea with the true state of things is "in reality".
approach_zh: 第一句给出了一种“人们很容易产生的想法”：两部连环漫画的主要目的都是逗人发笑。第二句对它作了纠正：《Wee Pals》同样着力于用社会政治评论引发读者思考。用真实情况取代一种看似合理的错误想法，过渡语要用“in reality”（实际上）。

approach_en: The second sentence gives a problem: raw acorns are very bitter. The third gives what had to be done because of it: the acorns needed processing before being eaten. That is cause followed by result.
approach_zh: 第二句给出了一个问题：生橡子非常苦。第三句给出了因此必须做的事：橡子要先加工才能吃。这是先说原因、再说结果。

approach_en: The first sentence may leave a strange impression: rock of two very different ages lies side by side with nothing between. The second sentence removes the wrong idea a reader might form, by stating something obvious: time did not stop; the missing rock was worn away. "Of course" introduces a point the reader is expected to accept as obvious.
approach_zh: 第一句可能让人产生奇怪的印象：年代相差极大的两种岩石紧挨在一起，中间什么也没有。第二句通过说出一个显而易见的事实，消除读者可能产生的误解：时间并没有停止，缺失的岩层是被侵蚀掉了。“Of course”（当然）引出的正是读者理应认同的显而易见的事实。

approach_en: Two conditions. The sentence must introduce the album Acoustic Soul, so the album should be its subject. And the audience already knows India Arie, so the sentence need not explain who she is.
approach_zh: 有两个条件。这句话要介绍的是专辑《Acoustic Soul》，所以专辑应当是句子的主体。而听众已经熟悉 India Arie，所以不需要再解释她是谁。

approach_en: The goal is to stress how strong the umami of winged kelp is. Only one note answers that: participants "rated its umami intensity as moderate". The right choice must report that rating.
approach_zh: 目标是强调翅藻的鲜味强度。只有一条笔记回答了这个问题：参与者“把它的鲜味强度评为中等”。正确选项必须说出这个评分结果。

approach_en: The goal is to say when the Chacoan peccary was identified. The notes give the year: 1974. The right choice must be about the peccary and must give that year.
approach_zh: 目标是说明草原西貒（Chacoan peccary）是什么时候被确认的。笔记给出了年份：1974年。正确选项必须讲的是草原西貒，并且给出这个年份。

approach_en: The second sentence explains the blank with "because": all art "draws on what has already been created by others". Art that takes from earlier work and is not fully original is described by the missing word. The first sentence uses a similar word, "hackneyed", for AI art.
approach_zh: 第二句用 because 解释了空格处的词：一切艺术都“从别人已经创造的东西中汲取灵感”。从前人的作品中取材、并非完全原创的艺术，就是空格处的词所形容的。第一句对人工智能艺术用了一个意思相近的词 hackneyed（陈腐的）。

approach_en: The words after "given that" explain the blank: her recitals can include a performance, "but also" a lecture and a slideshow. An event with several different parts has many sides. The missing word must mean that.
approach_zh: “given that”后面的话解释了空格处的词：她的独奏会既有演奏，“还有”讲座和幻灯片。一场包含好几种不同内容的活动，是多方面的。空格处的词必须是这个意思。

approach_en: The underlined part is the two questions: "What if India had started the Industrial Revolution? What if Soviet cosmonauts had been first to land on the moon?" The sentence before says this kind of fiction is built on "what if?" questions. The two questions are examples of them.
approach_zh: 画线部分是两个问句：“假如工业革命是从印度开始的呢？假如最先登上月球的是苏联宇航员呢？”前一句说这类小说的情节围绕“假如……会怎样”的问题展开。这两个问句就是这类问题的例子。

approach_en: The underlined part is "On receiving good news, people's first instinct might be to immediately share it". The study then compares exactly this, sharing good news, with keeping it secret, and measures how people felt. So the underlined part sets out a situation whose effect on people's feelings the study examined.
approach_zh: 画线部分是“得到好消息时，人们的第一反应可能是马上与人分享”。随后的研究正是把“分享好消息”与“保守秘密”作比较，测量人们的感受。所以画线部分摆出的是一种情形，而这项研究考察的正是这种情形对人心理的影响。

approach_en: The passage makes two connected points. First, the word "culture" has no agreed meaning: it is "hazy". Second, in the last sentence, researchers need a standard definition "if sociology is to truly progress". The main idea must contain both points.
approach_zh: 文章讲了相互关联的两点。第一，“culture”这个词没有公认的含义，是个模糊（hazy）的概念。第二（最后一句），研究者需要统一这个术语，“社会学才能真正进步”。主旨必须同时包含这两点。

approach_en: Notice who is speaking in every sentence: Robeyns "criticizes", "cites" and "argues". The passage reports one scholar's criticism of certain economic policies and her view that stricter regulation would have avoided a huge cost. The topic is her argument, not the crisis itself.
approach_zh: 注意每一句的主语都是 Robeyns：她“批评”“举例”“认为”。文章转述的是一位学者对某些经济政策的批评，以及她认为更严格的监管本可以避免巨额支出的看法。主题是她的论点，而不是那场危机本身。

approach_en: The weakness is whatever the "other scholars" object to. They say the report rests on a one-sided ("tendentious") view of how happiness and well-being are related, and their example is that people in some non-Western countries value other ideals above personal happiness. So the report may misjudge well-being where happiness matters less.
approach_zh: 所谓“缺陷”，就是文中“其他学者”所批评的地方。他们认为这份报告对幸福感与福祉之间关系的理解带有倾向性（tendentious），并举例说，在一些非西方国家，人们把别的理想看得比个人幸福更重要。所以在不那么看重幸福感的地方，报告可能会错估人们的福祉。

approach_en: Emerson calls scholars the guardians of thought, standing for "the spiritual interest of the world". He then says it is a disaster for everyone ("a common calamity") if they give up this role in a country like America, where "the material interest" dominates. So: where people care most about material gain, someone must look after ideas.
approach_zh: 爱默生把学者称作思想的守护者，代表着“世界的精神利益”。他接着说，在美国这样“物质利益”占主导的国家，如果学者放弃这一职责，那是所有人的灾难（a common calamity）。也就是说：在人们最看重物质利益的地方，必须有人守护思想。

approach_en: The passage has two steps. Step one: politicians try to support the policies their voters favor. Step two ("but"): their picture of what voters want comes largely from direct contact, and the people who make contact are not typical. The main idea joins the two: they aim to follow voters' wishes, yet may misjudge those wishes.
approach_zh: 文章分两步。第一步：政治人物力求支持选民赞成的政策。第二步（but 之后）：他们对选民意愿的了解主要来自直接接触，而主动接触他们的人并不具有代表性。主旨把两步连在一起：他们想顺应选民的意愿，却可能看错了这些意愿。

approach_en: The hypothesis is that steel is better than concrete for the lower floors of a tall building. The passage says what lower floors must do: "support the enormous weight of the upper floors". So look for a result in which the concrete version did worse at carrying that weight.
approach_zh: 假说是：高层建筑的底部楼层用钢材比用混凝土更合适。文中说明了底部楼层的任务：“支撑上部楼层巨大的重量”。所以要找的结果是：混凝土的那一座在承重方面表现更差。

approach_en: The claim has two parts: the temple's users (1) knew that materials inside the building affect sound and (2) used that knowledge on purpose ("deliberately") to shape how sound was heard. The right quotation must show people placing a material in order to change the sound.
approach_zh: 这个论断有两点：神庙的使用者（1）知道建筑内部使用的材料会影响声音；（2）有意（deliberately）运用这一知识来影响人们在这个空间里听到的声音。正确的引文必须说到人们为了改变声音而布置某种材料。

approach_en: The last sentence gives one explanation and then casts doubt on it with "but". The cactus has "not been observed" in parts of the mountains, and people have blamed a lack of suitable habitat. But the area is "notoriously inaccessible": hard to get to. If few people can reach it, the cactus may simply not have been looked for well enough.
approach_zh: 最后一句先给出一种解释，再用 but 对它提出怀疑。在这片山区的部分地方“没有观察到”这种仙人掌，人们把原因归结为缺少合适的生境。但这片地区“出了名的难以到达”。如果很少有人能进去，那么这种仙人掌很可能只是没有被充分地寻找过。

approach_en: The finding compares two cases. Using several diversification practices at once did more for both biodiversity (the environmental side) and yields (the economic side) than using one practice alone. So the two goals do not have to compete, but relying on a single practice, such as crop variety only, gives a weaker chance of gaining both.
approach_zh: 这项发现比较了两种情况。同时采用多种多样化措施，比只采用一种措施更有可能同时改善生物多样性（环境方面）和产量（经济方面）。所以这两个目标不一定互相冲突；但如果只依靠一种做法，比如只增加作物种类，两者兼得的可能性就小一些。

approach_en: After the colon comes a list of three works. Each item has its own comma ("title, which ..."), so the items must be separated by something stronger: semicolons. The list already uses a semicolon before "and The Ploughman's Tale", so the blank needs one too.
approach_zh: 冒号后面列举了三部作品。每一项内部都有逗号（“作品名, which ...”），所以项与项之间要用比逗号更强的标点，也就是分号。“and The Ploughman's Tale”前面已经用了分号，空格处也要用分号。

approach_en: Find the main verb of the second sentence: "The drone ... flew in a pattern". Since "flew" is already the main verb, the blank cannot hold another full verb. It needs an "-ing" form that describes the drone: "the drone photographing the landscape".
approach_zh: 先找第二句的谓语：“The drone ... flew in a pattern”。既然 flew 已经是谓语，空格处就不能再放一个完整的谓语动词，而需要一个修饰 drone 的 -ing 形式：“the drone photographing the landscape”（拍摄地貌的那架无人机）。

approach_en: The subject is the whole phrase "Distinguishing "exactly the same" and "nearly the same" commodities". An "-ing" phrase used as a subject counts as one thing, so it takes a singular verb. The sentence also needs a real main verb, and the time is past (the researchers worked in 2021).
approach_zh: 主语是整个短语“Distinguishing “exactly the same” and “nearly the same” commodities”。动名词短语作主语算作一件事，谓语用单数。句子还需要一个真正的谓语动词，时间是过去（研究者的工作是在2021年）。

approach_en: "Not only ... but also" is a pair, and no punctuation should come between its two halves. The whole pair, "not only in India but also around the world", adds detail at the end of the sentence, so one dash before it is enough.
approach_zh: “not only ... but also”是成对使用的结构，两部分之间不应加标点。“not only in India but also around the world”整体是句末的补充说明，前面用一个破折号引出即可。

approach_en: The subject is "the five prior such events" and its verb is "all predate us". Between them comes a list of the five events, opened by a dash after "events". Whatever opens an interruption must also close it, so a dash is needed after "(65 mya)".
approach_zh: 主语是“the five prior such events”，谓语是“all predate us”。两者之间插入了这五次事件的名单，名单以 events 后面的破折号开头。插入成分用什么标点开头，就要用什么标点收尾，所以“(65 mya)”后面要用破折号。

approach_en: There are two sentences here. The first ends at "pineapples". The second is "For the small group of wealthy consumers ..., the fruits had become a status symbol": an introductory "For ..." phrase, a comma, then the main statement. A period must separate the two.
approach_zh: 这里有两个句子。第一句到 pineapples 结束。第二句是“For the small group of wealthy consumers ..., the fruits had become a status symbol”：先是 For 引导的句首短语，接逗号，再是主句。两句之间要用句号。

approach_en: Read the sentence without the names: "one of the many shortcomings [that] the team discovered while analyzing nearly 400 studies". "While analyzing ..." tells when the team discovered the shortcomings, so it belongs closely with "discovered" and needs no punctuation.
approach_zh: 把人名去掉来读：“one of the many shortcomings [that] the team discovered while analyzing nearly 400 studies”。“while analyzing ...”说明团队是在什么时候发现这些缺陷的，与 discovered 关系紧密，中间不需要任何标点。

approach_en: The first sentence may suggest that all North American ungulates were studied. The second corrects that: not all of them, only elk in Wyoming. The first half of the second sentence goes against what the reader would expect, so it ends with "however", and the semicolon then joins the two complete statements.
approach_zh: 第一句可能让人以为所有北美有蹄类动物都被研究了。第二句纠正了这一点：并不是全部，只研究了怀俄明州的驼鹿。第二句的前半部分与读者的预期相反，所以用 however 收尾，然后用分号连接前后两个完整的句子。

approach_en: The first sentence gives the early reaction: the tower was criticized and even protested. The second gives how things ended: it won acceptance and adoration, and its design is now copied. The second sentence is the final outcome after time has passed, the opposite of the start.
approach_zh: 第一句讲的是最初的反应：这座塔受到批评，甚至遭到抗议。第二句讲的是最后的结局：它赢得了认可和喜爱，如今它的设计还被人模仿。第二句是一段时间之后的最终结果，与开头正好相反。

approach_en: Frye says that even in poems and essays the writer is partly "a fictional hero with a fictional audience". The writer puts forward an invented version of the self to an imagined audience. "Fictional projection" names that putting forward. If it vanished, the writing would be plain "direct address".
approach_zh: Frye 说，即使在抒情诗和散文里，作者在某种程度上也是“一个面对虚构听众的虚构主人公”。作者向想象中的听众呈现出一个经过虚构的自我。“fictional projection”指的就是这种呈现。如果它消失了，文字就成了直白的“直接陈述”。

approach_en: The second sentence explains the blank. Blueprints are full of symbols that outsiders cannot understand, and the foreperson "must convert all of that ... into practical building instructions that are easily understood". Turning something from a form people cannot read into a form they can is what the missing word names.
approach_zh: 第二句解释了空格处的词。图纸上满是外行看不懂的符号，而领班“必须把这一切……转换成任何人都容易看懂的、切实可行的施工指令”。把人们看不懂的形式变成看得懂的形式，就是空格处的词所指的行为。

approach_en: Set the two ideas side by side. The statue shows "a powerful athlete", a woman in a strong pose. The idea mentioned is that women in these societies "held only passive roles". A powerful athlete does not fit a passive role, so the statue goes against that idea.
approach_zh: 把两个说法放在一起看。雕像表现的是“一位强有力的运动员”，一个姿态坚定的女性。句中提到的观念是，这些社会中的女性“只担任被动的角色”。强有力的运动员与被动的角色并不相符，所以这尊雕像与那种观念相抵触。

approach_en: The key fact is that people "with no musical training" could do this easily. An ability that people have without being taught may be one they are born with. The missing words must mean "natural to".
approach_zh: 关键的事实是：“没有受过音乐训练”的人也能轻松做到这一点。一种不用教就有的能力，可能是与生俱来的。空格处的词语必须表示“对……来说是天生的”。

approach_en: The first sentence makes a claim: Brown mixes scientific research, political activism and various media. The last sentence repeats it: the exhibition shows her "multidisciplinary approach and use of diverse sources". The underlined part, in between, lists what the exhibition actually contained: core samples, oil well data, archive material and video. Those details are the evidence for the claim.
approach_zh: 第一句提出论断：Brown 的创作融合了科学研究、政治行动和多种媒介。最后一句再次点明：这个展览体现了她“多学科的方法和对多样化素材的运用”。夹在中间的画线部分列出了展览实际包含的内容：岩芯样本、油井数据、档案资料和影像。这些细节就是那个论断的证据。

approach_en: After the introduction, every sentence describes weather and landscape: an unusual June, steady breezes, white clouds, cool shade, evening light on the valley. No person acts, and no difficulty arises. The passage paints the place and time in which the story happens.
approach_zh: 引言之后，每一句都在描写天气和景色：不同寻常的六月、平稳的微风、白云、凉爽的阴影、傍晚洒在山谷上的光。没有人物在行动，也没有出现什么难题。这段文字描绘的是故事发生的地点和时节。

approach_en: Read the speech in two halves around "but be sure". Before it, the king admits he has been too mild, and the noblemen have taken advantage of that. After it, he promises to be his true self from now on: "mighty and to be fear'd". The last lines give his reason: his gentleness cost him respect.
approach_zh: 以“but be sure”为界把这段话分成两半来读。前一半，国王承认自己过于温和，贵族们因此得寸进尺。后一半，他宣布从今以后要做回真正的自己：“强大而令人畏惧”。最后几行说明原因：他的温和使他失去了尊敬。

approach_en: The claim in the last sentence is that residents' willingness to walk may be different now from ten years ago, so the old survey may mislead. The passage names what affects that willingness: "the perceived safety of the streets". Support would be a change in street safety over the last ten years.
approach_zh: 最后一句的说法是：居民如今愿意步行的距离可能与十年前不同，所以旧调查可能会误导选址。文中交代了影响这种意愿的因素：“人们感受到的街道安全程度”。能支持这个说法的，是过去十年里街道安全状况发生了变化。

approach_en: The hypothesis is that silver nanoparticle levels in earthworms could stand in for ("serve a proxy role") levels in vertebrates such as mice, so that mice would not need to be sampled. A proxy works only if one measurement tells you about the other. The finding that weakens it is one showing the two do not go together.
approach_zh: 假说是：蚯蚓体内的银纳米颗粒水平可以充当小鼠等脊椎动物体内水平的替代指标（proxy），这样就不必再对小鼠取样。替代指标要成立，前提是从一个测量值能推知另一个。能削弱它的发现，就是两者并不相关。

approach_en: The claim gives the features to look for: a world made up "entirely of two-dimensional geometric figures" whose existence is "confined to the surface of a plane". The right quotation must show flat shapes that cannot leave their surface.
approach_zh: 这个说法给出了要找的特征：一个“完全由二维几何图形构成”的世界，这些图形的存在“被限制在一个平面的表面上”。正确的引文必须写出一些无法离开所在平面的扁平图形。

approach_en: Compare the two approaches. The transplant method used at Los Corchos works but is "challenging at scale", because each piece of coral must be grown and moved by hand. The new approach is a coating that is "simple-to-apply" and made from "inexpensive and abundant" ingredients. Something simple, cheap and plentiful can be used far more widely.
approach_zh: 比较两种方法。Los Corchos 采用的移植法有效，但“难以大规模推行”，因为每一块珊瑚都要先培育再逐个移栽。新方法是一种涂层，“容易涂敷”，原料“便宜而且充足”。简单、便宜又充足的东西可以在大得多的范围内使用。

approach_en: Notice the gas in each sentence. Methanogens live "in oxygen-poor environments". The passage then says this group arose as early as 3.5 billion years ago and would have been "well-adapted to conditions then". The reason must be that there was very little oxygen at that time.
approach_zh: 注意每句话里提到的气体。产甲烷菌生活在“缺氧的环境”里。文章接着说这类生物早在35亿年前就出现了，并且“很适应当时的条件”。原因必然是当时氧气非常少。

approach_en: Follow the mechanism the passage gives. Insect feeding makes stomata close; closed stomata let in less carbon dioxide; less carbon dioxide means less photosynthesis. Plants giving off the insect-deterring compound lost less photosynthesis, and the plants differed in nothing else. So those plants must have kept their stomata more open.
approach_zh: 顺着文中给出的机制来推。昆虫取食使气孔关闭；气孔关闭后进入叶片的二氧化碳减少；二氧化碳减少，光合作用就减弱。释放驱虫化合物的植物光合作用下降得较少，而两类植物在其他方面没有差别。所以这些植物的气孔一定张开得更多。

approach_en: Inside the clause "that regions with large human populations were unlikely to yield discoveries", the subject is "regions with large human populations" and the verb is "were". Nothing may separate a subject from its verb, and adding "which" would take the verb away from "regions".
approach_zh: 在从句“that regions with large human populations were unlikely to yield discoveries”里，主语是“regions with large human populations”，谓语是 were。主语和谓语之间不能加标点；加上 which 则会让 regions 失去谓语。

approach_en: "Fluid impedes sound considerably more than air does" is a complete sentence, so a period follows "does". In the next sentence the subject is "Impedance matching" and the verb is "recruits". Between them, "the process by which ... inner ear" renames the subject and must have a comma on each side. No extra verb may be added.
approach_zh: “Fluid impedes sound considerably more than air does”是完整的句子，does 后面用句号。下一句的主语是“Impedance matching”，谓语是 recruits。两者之间的“the process by which ... inner ear”是说明主语的同位语，前后都要有逗号，并且不能再添加别的谓语动词。

approach_en: The second sentence has a subject, "The widespread use of this locally produced material", but no main verb yet: the "which ..." clause between the commas only describes the material. The blank must supply the main verb, in the past tense because the passage is about the nineteenth century.
approach_zh: 第二句有主语“The widespread use of this locally produced material”，但还没有谓语：两个逗号之间的 which 从句只是在修饰这种材料。空格处必须填上谓语动词；文章讲的是19世纪，所以用过去时。

approach_en: "In an interview for the book Latina Authors and Their Muses" is an introductory phrase: it tells where something happened but has no subject and verb. The main sentence starts with "fantasy author Dora Machado revealed ...". A comma separates an introductory phrase from the main sentence.
approach_zh: “In an interview for the book Latina Authors and Their Muses”是句首短语，说明事情发生的场合，没有主语和谓语。主句从“fantasy author Dora Machado revealed ...”开始。句首短语和主句之间用逗号隔开。

approach_en: The time is stated: "In January 2021", a finished moment in the past. An action completed at a stated past time takes the simple past. The rest of the sentence agrees: "had the second-best job".
approach_zh: 时间已经写明：“In January 2021”，是过去的一个确定时间。在明确的过去时间里完成的动作用一般过去时。句子的其余部分也与此一致：“had the second-best job”。

approach_en: The subject is "this one-ton machine", singular. The long part between the dashes only describes the machine. Skip it and read: "this one-ton machine ... programmed with time delays". A singular, past-tense verb is needed.
approach_zh: 主语是“this one-ton machine”，单数。两个破折号之间的长段只是在描述这台机器。跳过它来读：“this one-ton machine ... programmed with time delays”，需要一个单数、过去时的动词。

approach_en: The two sentences describe opposite seasons with opposite effects. In winter the jet stream moves south and brings cold air. In summer it moves north and lets warm air spread. A word for "in the opposite way" is needed.
approach_zh: 两句话描述的是相反的季节和相反的效果。冬季，急流南移，带来冷空气；夏季，急流北移，让暖空气扩散开来。这里需要一个表示“反过来”的词。

approach_en: The passage lists stages in order, each marked by a word: "First", "Next", "Then". The sentence with the blank gives the last stage: the tail disappears and the tadpole becomes an adult frog. The last item in a sequence takes "finally".
approach_zh: 文章按顺序列出了各个阶段，每个阶段都有一个标志词：First、Next、Then。空格所在的句子讲的是最后一个阶段：尾巴消失，蝌蚪变成成年的青蛙。顺序中的最后一项用 finally。

approach_en: The first sentence says that in the past the White House held many unusual pets. The words after the blank say that for decades nearly every pet has been a cat or dog. The missing words must turn from the unusual past to the ordinary present and lead smoothly into the clause after the semicolon.
approach_zh: 第一句说，过去白宫里养过各种各样不寻常的宠物。空格之后说，最近几十年，白宫的宠物几乎都是猫或狗。空格处的内容必须从不寻常的过去转到寻常的现在，并且自然地接上分号后面的分句。

approach_en: The first sentence is positive: stargazers could enjoy the beautiful total eclipse. The sentence after the blank limits that: they had "just one minute, fifty-five seconds". The missing sentence must turn from the enjoyment to the shortness of the event.
approach_zh: 第一句是正面的：观星者能欣赏到美丽的日全食。空格后面的那句对此作了限定：他们“只有一分五十五秒”。空格处的句子必须从“能欣赏”转到“时间很短”。

approach_en: The goal is to say when dotted blue butterflies are most active. One note answers that directly: "They are most active during the day."
approach_zh: 目标是说明 dotted blue 蝴蝶什么时候最活跃。有一条笔记直接回答了这个问题：“它们在白天最活跃。”

approach_en: The goal is to say what the two juices have in common. Their pH values differ (3.4 and 4.0), but both are below 7, and the notes say anything below 7 is acidic. So what they share is being acidic.
approach_zh: 目标是说出两种果汁的共同点。它们的 pH 值不同（3.4和4.0），但都低于7，而笔记说 pH 值低于7的物质是酸性的。所以它们的共同点是都呈酸性。

approach_en: The usual picture is revolutionary artists against a "static" middle-class culture: movement against standing still. Levenson rejects that picture and calls the conflict "a contest of novelties", that is, a contest between two things that were both producing something new. So he must be saying that the middle-class culture was also changing.
approach_zh: 通常的看法是：革命性的艺术家对抗一个“静止不变的”中产阶级文化，也就是变动对抗停滞。Levenson 不接受这种看法，把这场冲突称为“新事物之间的竞争”，即双方都在产生新东西。所以他一定是在说，中产阶级文化同样在变化。

approach_en: The first sentence says most studies of uranium in water were done in oceans. "Therefore" the new study turned to lakes, to deal with the state of knowledge about inland waters. If most work was on oceans, there was little on inland waters. The missing word must mean "shortage".
approach_zh: 第一句说，关于水中铀的研究大多是在海洋环境中做的。therefore（因此）之后，新的研究转向了湖泊，以应对内陆水体相关知识的状况。既然大部分研究针对的是海洋，那么针对内陆水体的研究就很少。空格处的词必须表示“缺乏”。

approach_en: Two forests are contrasted with "but". At the Tyson Center, how rare a species is goes together with whether its trees grow in same-species clumps: rare species clump more. At Mo Singto the reason given is that rare species have their seeds carried away by animals, so their trees are scattered whether the species is rare or common. There, clumping does not depend on how abundant the species is.
approach_zh: 句子用 but 对比了两片森林。在 Tyson 研究中心，一个物种稀有与否，与它的植株是否同种聚集有关：稀有物种更容易聚集。而在 Mo Singto，给出的原因是稀有物种的种子靠动物带走，所以无论物种稀有还是常见，植株都是分散的。在那里，是否聚集并不取决于物种的多少。

approach_en: There were casual, unsystematic observations ("anecdotal") that these flowers shut out many pollinators. The analysis of 50,000 records found the same thing: they are visited by a smaller set of pollinators. Solid data that agree with casual observations confirm them. The missing word must mean "giving proof of".
approach_zh: 此前有一些零散的、不成体系的观察（anecdotal）认为，这类花把许多传粉者拒之门外。对5万条记录的分析得出了同样的结论：光顾它们的传粉者种类更少。扎实的数据与零散的观察一致，就是证实了这些观察。空格处的词必须表示“为……提供证据”。

approach_en: The second sentence explains the relation: developments at the earlier Mirador sites were "a historical precondition" for the skill of architects in later cities such as Palenque. A later city that gains from what earlier places achieved is one that benefits from them.
approach_zh: 第二句解释了两者的关系：较早的 Mirador 遗址的发展，是 Palenque 这类后来的城市的建筑师展现出高超技艺的“历史前提”。后来的城市从先前各地的成就中得益，就是这些成就的受益者。

approach_en: The passage sets up a puzzle and answers it. Fact: merchants rarely use exact prices. Complication: shoppers think well of exact prices. Question: "so why aren't they more common?" Answer: exact prices take more mental effort to handle. The purpose is to explain why exact prices stay rare even though they are well regarded.
approach_zh: 文章先提出一个疑问，再回答它。事实：商家很少用精确的价格。矛盾之处：消费者对精确价格的印象不错。问题：“那它们为什么不更常见？”回答：精确价格处理起来更费脑子。这段文字的目的，是解释为什么精确价格虽然印象不错，却仍然少见。

approach_en: The underlined part reports earlier research: "some studies have suggested that petal length may indicate nectar volume". The same sentence then says Maglianesi's team "found no such association". So the underlined part mentions a possible link between two features of flowers, and the later study did not find it.
approach_zh: 画线部分转述了以前的研究：“有些研究提出，花瓣的长度可能反映花蜜的多少”。同一句话接着说，Maglianesi 团队“没有发现这样的关联”。所以画线部分提到的是花的两种特征之间可能存在的联系，而后面的研究并没有发现这种联系。

approach_en: The first sentence states the conclusion: over 8 million years the Middle East moved "away from stable, relatively high humidity". The two underlined parts are the evidence. Old formations are clear calcite, a sign of water regularly renewed by rain. Young formations are branching, cloudy material with breaks in growth, a sign of an on-and-off water supply. Put together, they show the change.
approach_zh: 第一句给出了结论：800万年来，中东地区逐渐“告别了稳定的、相对较高的湿度”。两处画线部分就是证据。古老的洞穴沉积物是透明的方解石，说明地下水经常得到雨水补给；年轻的洞穴沉积物是分枝状、不透明的物质，生长中常有间断，说明水的供应时有时无。两者合起来，就显示出了这种变化。

approach_en: The first sentence states the theme: very heavy synthetic elements can be "challenging to classify". Each experiment that follows gives a different answer about flerovium (Fl): like a noble gas, like a volatile metal, and somewhere between mercury and radon. The main idea is that Fl does not fit neatly into the existing groups.
approach_zh: 第一句点明了主题：原子核很重的人造元素可能“难以归类”。随后的每个实验对 Fl（flerovium，鈇）都给出不同的答案：像稀有气体、像易挥发的金属、活泼性介于汞和氡之间。主旨是：Fl 不能整齐地归入现有的类别。

approach_en: The passage says Marshall saw the courts as a way to bring about social reform, which broke with the older habit of using them mainly to clarify or adjust existing laws. The Brown case is given as the moment this view "was realized". So its influence was to show that courts could produce major social change.
approach_zh: 文章说 Marshall 把诉讼看作实现社会改革的途径，这有别于过去主要用法院来澄清或修改现有法律的传统。Brown 案被说成这一设想“得以实现”的时刻。所以它的影响在于表明：法院可以带来重大的社会变革。

approach_en: The student's claim is that Schoonmaker's aim was to keep the viewer's attention on the actors' performances, even at the cost of small mismatches between shots. She "achieved her goal" if a viewer was so taken up with the acting that the mismatch went unseen.
approach_zh: 学生的观点是：Schoonmaker 的目标是让观众的注意力集中在演员的表演上，哪怕镜头之间出现一些小的不连贯。如果观众完全被表演吸引，以至于没有看到不连贯的地方，那她就“达到了目标”。

approach_en: The claim is about pairs of calls: bonobos put calls in specific orders, and the pair means something that the single calls do not ("the order carries meaning in addition to the sounds themselves"). Support needs a call whose meaning changes when another call is placed before it.
approach_zh: 这个说法讲的是成对的叫声：倭黑猩猩会按特定的顺序把叫声组合起来，组合所表达的意思是单个叫声所没有的（“除了声音本身，顺序也携带意义”）。能支持它的，是某个叫声在前面加上另一个叫声之后意思发生了变化。

approach_en: The last sentence gives one explanation and then casts doubt on it with "but". The cactus has "not been observed" in eastern and western Coahuila, and people have blamed a lack of suitable habitat. But the area is "notoriously inaccessible": hard to get to. If few people can reach it, the cactus may simply not have been looked for well enough.
approach_zh: 最后一句先给出一种解释，再用 but 对它提出怀疑。在 Coahuila 州的东部和西部“没有观察到”这种仙人掌，人们把原因归结为缺少合适的生境。但这片地区“出了名的难以到达”。如果很少有人能进去，那么这种仙人掌很可能只是没有被充分地寻找过。

approach_en: The passage names the doubt in advance: fewer artifacts may show a real change in culture, or may only reflect "gaps in the archaeological record". To call the drop in gold a real change, the gap explanation must be ruled out. If far more sites from after 1500 BCE have been studied than from before, and yet they hold fewer gold objects, the drop cannot be blamed on too few sites.
approach_zh: 文章事先点明了疑问：器物变少可能说明文化上确实发生了变化，也可能只是“考古记录有缺口”造成的。要把黄金器物的减少认定为真实的变化，就必须排除“记录有缺口”这种解释。如果数据集中1500年以后的遗址远多于以前的遗址，黄金器物却反而更少，那么这种减少就不能归咎于遗址太少。

approach_en: The subject is "Such innovations", plural. The phrase between the commas ("developed to address ... modern ballet") only describes the innovations. Skip it and read "Such innovations ... the evolution". A plural subject needs a plural verb.
approach_zh: 主语是“Such innovations”，复数。两个逗号之间的“developed to address ... modern ballet”只是在修饰 innovations。跳过它来读：“Such innovations ... the evolution”。复数主语要用复数形式的动词。

approach_en: The subject is the "-ing" phrase "Having proportionally large populations". An "-ing" phrase used as a subject counts as one thing and takes a singular verb. The sentence states a general fact, so the present tense fits.
approach_zh: 主语是动名词短语“Having proportionally large populations”。动名词短语作主语算作一件事，谓语用单数。这句话陈述的是一般事实，用现在时。

approach_en: The subject is "Each", not "scripts". "Each of these scripts" means every single one, so the verb is singular. The clause between the commas ("which include ...") is extra.
approach_zh: 主语是 Each，不是 scripts。“Each of these scripts”指其中的每一种，所以谓语用单数。两个逗号之间的“which include ...”是补充成分。

approach_en: The first sentence ends at "manufactured goods". The second begins "That Bermuda relies on manufactured goods ...". Here "That ..." means "the fact that ...": the whole clause is the subject of the verb "places". So a period comes before "That".
approach_zh: 第一句到“manufactured goods”结束。第二句以“That Bermuda relies on manufactured goods ...”开头，这里的 That 相当于“the fact that”（……这一事实），整个从句作谓语 places 的主语。所以 That 前面用句号。

approach_en: Compare the two sentences. The first says the book describes color systems in "vivid prose", that is, in words. The second says the book has many high-quality images. Words and images are two separate good points of the same book, so the second sentence adds to the first.
approach_zh: 比较前后两句。第一句说这本书用“生动的文字”描述了各种颜色体系，也就是靠文字。第二句说这本书有许多高质量的图片。文字和图片是同一本书的两个不同的优点，所以第二句是对第一句的补充。

approach_en: Simpson sorts countries by a number: a population under one million. Theys proposes something else: let a small country define its own status "rather than relying on ... quantitative standards". Her approach opposes his, so the transition must say that she is arguing against that way of sorting.
approach_zh: Simpson 按一个数字给国家归类：人口不足一百万。Theys 提出了另一种办法：让小国自己界定自己的地位，“而不是依靠……数量标准”。她的办法与他的相对立，所以过渡语必须表明她是在反驳那种归类方式。

approach_en: The first sentence shows that the trucks carry verses and slogans expressing the drivers' values and humor. The words after the blank say the owners spend a great deal on decoration and see the trucks as "personal artistic creations". The missing words must connect the two: the owners value their trucks as a place for creative expression.
approach_zh: 第一句说明这些卡车上有诗句和标语，表达着司机的价值观和幽默感。空格之后说车主在装饰上投入很大，把卡车看作“个人的艺术创作”。空格处的内容必须把这两点连起来：车主把卡车当作发挥创造力的地方来珍视。

approach_en: The goal is to challenge the model, using only what the notes say. The notes say the model divides plankton into phytoplankton or zooplankton, and that this division leaves out ("excluding") mixotrophic plankton. A challenge should point to that gap without adding claims the notes do not contain.
approach_zh: 目标是质疑这个模型，而且只能用笔记里的内容。笔记说，这个模型把浮游生物分成浮游植物和浮游动物两类，这种划分把混合营养型浮游生物排除在外（excluding）。质疑就应当指出这个缺口，同时不能添加笔记里没有的说法。

approach_en: The goal is to stress what the two newspapers share geographically, that is, in place. From the notes: one ran in New York City and the other in Syracuse, and both cities are in the state of New York. The right choice must make that shared state its main point and get every fact right.
approach_zh: 目标是强调两份报纸在地理上的相似之处，也就是地点上的共同点。从笔记可知：一份在纽约市发行，另一份在 Syracuse 发行，这两座城市都在纽约州。正确选项必须把“同在一个州”作为重点，并且每个事实都要准确。

approach_en: A new audience knows nothing about Mexía, so an introduction should say who she was and what she is known for overall. The notes give both: she was a botanist, and she collected more than 150,000 samples across the Americas between 1917 and 1938. Single samples are details for later.
approach_zh: 新的读者对 Mexía 一无所知，所以介绍应当说明她是谁、总体上以什么著称。笔记给出了这两点：她是植物学家；1917至1938年间，她在美洲各地采集了15万多份植物标本。个别标本属于以后再谈的细节。

approach_en: The sentence gives two facts about sashiko: it began as a practical way of mending, and its patterns come from everyday life. Both show folk art taking its form and themes "from the lives of its creators". The missing word must mean "get from".
approach_zh: 这句话给出了关于 sashiko 的两个事实：它起源于一种实用的缝补方法，它的图案取材于日常生活。两者都说明民间艺术的形式和主题“来自创作者的生活”。空格处的词必须表示“从……取得”。

approach_en: The second sentence explains the first. Handing simple, repetitive tasks to machines "has enabled workers to shift" to more demanding tasks. That shift is "the redistribution of human labor", and automation made it possible. The missing word must mean "made easier" or "helped bring about".
approach_zh: 第二句解释了第一句。把简单、重复的任务交给机器，“使工人得以转向”要求更高的任务。这种转移就是“人力的重新分配”，而自动化使它成为可能。空格处的词必须表示“使……更容易”“促成”。

approach_en: "While some people believe" sets up a belief that the sentence then corrects with "actually". The belief: closing vents saves money. The correction: it makes the system work worse, by restricting airflow and making motors "work harder". A system that works harder for the same result has become less efficient.
approach_zh: “While some people believe”先摆出一种看法，随后句子用 actually 加以纠正。看法是：关上通风口可以省钱。纠正是：这样做会让系统运转得更差，因为气流受阻，电机要“更费力地工作”。同样的效果却要更费力，就是效率降低了。

approach_en: Gogol finds it satisfying that after years of schooling and "unbuilt projects", "his efforts are to have some practical end". His work will now be used in real buildings. "End" here means what the efforts are for.
approach_zh: Gogol 感到欣慰的是，经过多年的学校教育和那些“没有建成的项目”，“他的努力终于有了某种实际的 end”。他的工作现在要用到真实的建筑上了。这里的 end 指的是这些努力为了什么。

approach_en: Sentence 1 reports a success: the remake earned over $28 million in its first weekend. Sentence 2 begins "One reason for its popularity" and names the marketing. Sentences 3 and 4 give the details and results of that marketing. The passage explains why the advertising worked.
approach_zh: 第1句报告了一项成功：这部翻拍片上映首周末票房超过2,800万美元。第2句以“它受欢迎的原因之一”开头，指出了营销的作用。第3、4句给出了这次营销的具体做法和效果。这段文字是在解释这次宣传为什么成功。

approach_en: Take the sentences one at a time. Sentence 1 names a biography: Edison by Edmund Morris. Sentence 2 lists parts of Edison's life that the book covers. Sentence 3, with "However", points to an unusual feature, telling the life backward, and quotes a reviewer who disliked it.
approach_zh: 逐句来看。第1句提到一部传记：Edmund Morris 写的《Edison》。第2句列举了书中写到的爱迪生生平的几个部分。第3句用 However 指出了一个不寻常的特点（倒着写生平），并引用了一位不喜欢这种写法的书评人的话。

approach_en: The passage has two halves. The first presents a finding: many air-breathing sea animals swim at a depth about three times their body width to save energy. The second says why it matters: "This finding has important implications for animal conservation efforts", with the example of avoiding boat strikes on whales.
approach_zh: 文章分两部分。前一部分介绍了一项发现：许多用肺呼吸的海洋动物在大约三倍于自身体宽的深度游动，以节省能量。后一部分说明了它为什么重要：“这一发现对动物保护工作有重要意义”，并举了避免船只撞击鲸的例子。

approach_en: Look at the images the author uses for the tiyospaye: "a warm womb cradling all within it", children "never alone", "fussed over by ... several mothers, watched and taught by several fathers". Each one is about care and protection for everyone inside the group.
approach_zh: 看作者描写 tiyospaye 时用的意象：“像温暖的子宫，怀抱着其中的每一个人”，孩子们“从不孤单”，“有好几位母亲疼爱，有好几位父亲照看和教导”。每一处讲的都是群体对其中每个人的关爱和保护。

approach_en: This question asks for a stated detail. Find the sentence that reports the conclusion: "They concluded that gratitude letter and best possible self showed the most consistent benefits". Then match the two names exactly.
approach_zh: 这道题考的是文中明确写出的细节。找到陈述结论的那句话：“They concluded that gratitude letter and best possible self showed the most consistent benefits”，再把这两个名称原样对上。

approach_en: Strip the sentence to its frame: "Like this alabaster box ..., is my heart". The speaker says her heart is like the box. The lines in between describe the box; the lines after describe the heart in the same terms.
approach_zh: 把句子缩成主干：“Like this alabaster box ..., is my heart”，意思是“我的心就像这只雪花石膏盒子”。中间几行描写盒子，后面几行用同样的方式描写心。

approach_en: The underlined claim is the last sentence: the Carolina dog "likely has such an origin too", that is, it descends from dogs that came from Asia. The passage has just shown what counts as evidence for this: the Inuit dog has genetic markers "found in the dogs of East Asia but absent in those of Europe". The same kind of evidence for the Carolina dog would support the claim.
approach_zh: 画线的说法是最后一句：卡罗来纳犬“很可能也有这样的起源”，即它是从亚洲迁来的狗的后代。文中刚刚说明了什么可以作为这种起源的证据：因纽特犬带有“东亚的狗身上有、欧洲的狗身上没有”的遗传标记。卡罗来纳犬如果有同样的证据，就能支持这个说法。

approach_en: The claim links a cause and an effect: climate in parts of California (cause) helped drive "innovation in irrigation techniques" (effect). The right quotation must show a condition of climate, such as too little water, leading to a new technique.
approach_zh: 这个论断把原因和结果联系在一起：加州部分地区的气候（原因）推动了“灌溉技术的创新”（结果）。正确的引文必须说到某种气候条件（比如缺水）催生了一种新技术。

approach_en: Two facts lead to the conclusion. Wayang artists have long exchanged knowledge with puppet artists from India and Persia, and today's performances add heroes and stories from Indian and Persian tales. So wayang now mixes material from other cultures with its Javanese base.
approach_zh: 两个事实引出结论。哇扬艺人很早就与印度和波斯的偶戏艺人相互学习；如今的演出还加入了印度和波斯故事里的英雄和情节。所以今天的哇扬在爪哇本土的基础上融入了其他文化的内容。

approach_en: The key word is "completely overlaps". The range of light that M cones react to lies entirely inside the ranges that L and S cones react to. So any light that sets off M cones also sets off L or S cones, and M cones cannot be switched on alone.
approach_zh: 关键词是“完全重叠”。M 视锥细胞能响应的光的范围，完全落在 L 和 S 视锥细胞能响应的范围之内。所以任何能激活 M 视锥细胞的光，也会激活 L 或 S 视锥细胞，M 视锥细胞无法被单独激活。

approach_en: The blank states the purpose: Ferreira hopes to use the antioxidants in order to do two things. A purpose is expressed with "to + verb", and two verbs joined by "and" must have the same form: "to prevent and treat".
approach_zh: 空格处表示目的：Ferreira 希望利用这些抗氧化剂去做两件事。目的用“to + 动词”表示；and 连接的两个动词形式必须一致：“to prevent and treat”。

approach_en: The first sentence names two tapestries: Palette of Cochineal and Winter in the North. The blank needs a subject that refers to exactly those two. "Both" means "the two of them" and takes a plural verb.
approach_zh: 第一句提到了两幅挂毯：《Palette of Cochineal》和《Winter in the North》。空格处需要一个正好指代这两幅作品的主语。both 的意思是“这两者”，后面用复数动词。

approach_en: The subject is "The perception", singular. Everything from "that a project has ..." to "examples" explains what the perception is. The verb must be singular, and the present tense fits a definition.
approach_zh: 主语是“The perception”，单数。从“that a project has ...”到 examples 都是在说明这种看法的内容。谓语用单数；这是在下定义，用现在时。

approach_en: The sentence is complete at "A Summary View of the Rights of British America". The words after the comma, "a pamphlet ...", rename that work. Inside this phrase the blank needs a form that describes "pamphlet", not a full verb: "a pamphlet presenting many of the principles".
approach_zh: 句子到“A Summary View of the Rights of British America”已经完整。逗号后面的“a pamphlet ...”是这部作品的同位语。在这个短语里，空格处需要一个修饰 pamphlet 的形式，而不是完整的谓语动词：“a pamphlet presenting many of the principles”（一本提出了许多原则的小册子）。

approach_en: The blank needs a possessive that points back to "the co-op model": the skeptics declared the model's means of governance unsustainable. "Model" is singular, so the word is "its".
approach_zh: 空格处需要一个所有格，指回“the co-op model”（合作社模式）：怀疑者宣称这种模式的治理方式不可持续。model 是单数，所以用 its。

approach_en: The first sentence makes a general statement: some famous novels first had very different titles. The second gives one case: Dickens first called Little Dorrit by the title Nobody's Fault. A general statement followed by one case calls for a phrase that introduces an example.
approach_zh: 第一句作了一般性的陈述：有些著名小说最初的书名与今天为人熟知的书名大不相同。第二句给出了一个实例：狄更斯最初把《小杜丽》叫作《Nobody's Fault》。先概括、再举一个实例，需要一个引出例子的短语。

approach_en: The first sentence says the dyeing process has "multiple steps". The third sentence begins with "Second". So the sentence with the blank, which comes between them, must be the first step.
approach_zh: 第一句说这种染色方法包含“多个步骤”。第三句以 Second 开头。那么夹在两者之间的空格所在句，一定是第一步。

approach_en: The first sentence: in 1863 visitors "openly scoffed" at these paintings. The second: the same paintings "were soon recognized as harbingers of an artistic revolution" and were praised. The second fact is surprising after the first, so the transition must mean "in spite of the bad start".
approach_zh: 第一句：1863年，参观者“公然嘲笑”这些画作。第二句：同样的这些画作“很快被公认为一场艺术革命的先声”，并受到称赞。有了前一个事实，后一个事实显得出人意料，所以过渡语的意思必须是“尽管开头不被看好”。

approach_en: The goal is to say how some fireflies use their lights for protection. Of the three notes, only one is about protection: the lights "help some fireflies warn off predators".
approach_zh: 目标是说明有些萤火虫怎样用闪光来保护自己。三条笔记里只有一条讲的是保护：闪光“帮助一些萤火虫吓退捕食者”。

approach_en: The goal covers two of the four steps: making the medium (step 2) and applying it (step 3). Step 2: melted wax and resin are mixed and pigment is added. Step 3: the medium is spread on the surface in layers, with heat so that each layer softens and fuses with the ones before. The right choice must report these two steps accurately and leave the others out.
approach_zh: 目标涉及四个步骤中的两个：制作介质（第2步）和涂敷介质（第3步）。第2步：把熔化的蜡和树脂混合，加入颜料。第3步：把介质一层层涂在画面上，并加热，使每一层软化并与前面的各层熔合。正确选项必须准确地讲出这两步，并且不掺入其他步骤。

approach_en: The goal is a historical similarity. The two terraces were built in different periods (Heian and Edo), so the period names are a difference. What the periods share, according to the notes, is that each "was characterized by economic stability and peace". That is the similarity to stress.
approach_zh: 目标是历史方面的相似之处。两处梯田建于不同的时期（平安时代和江户时代），所以时期的名称是不同点。按笔记的说法，这两个时期的共同之处是都“以经济稳定与和平为特征”。要强调的相似之处就是这一点。

approach_en: The end of the sentence shows the direction: the deposits end up "undermining the main function" of a water heater, which is to heat water. So large deposits must get in the way of heat passing into the water. The missing word must mean "block" or "slow down".
approach_zh: 句子的结尾指明了方向：这些沉积物最终会“损害”热水器的“主要功能”，也就是把水加热。所以大块的沉积物一定是妨碍了热量传到水里。空格处的词必须表示“阻碍”。

approach_en: The first sentence gives the purpose of the fellowship: "to raise public awareness about exceptional folk and traditional artists". Giving it to Sinenci therefore serves to bring his contributions to public notice. The missing word must mean "make better known".
approach_zh: 第一句说明了这个奖的宗旨：“提高公众对杰出的民间和传统艺术家的认识”。所以把它授予 Sinenci，就是为了让公众注意到他的贡献。空格处的词必须表示“宣扬、让更多人知道”。

approach_en: Two clues. The reason given: stories "often serve to transmit information cautioning about local wildlife", so the animals in a region's stories should be the animals that live there. And the second sentence calls British bear stories "an apparent exception", because bears no longer live there. So the usual pattern is that the two distributions match.
approach_zh: 有两条线索。给出的理由是：这类故事“往往用来传递有关当地野生动物的警示信息”，所以一个地区的故事里出现的动物，应当就是生活在那里的动物。第二句又把不列颠群岛的熊故事称为“明显的例外”，因为那里早已没有熊。所以通常的情况是两种分布相吻合。

approach_en: The second sentence gives the reason with "because": for established companies, new products "could compete with the sale of their existing products". That is a reason not to make new products. So these companies have fewer reasons pushing them to innovate. The missing word must mean "reasons to act".
approach_zh: 第二句用 because 给出了原因：对老牌公司来说，新产品“可能与它们现有产品的销售形成竞争”。这是不去做新产品的理由。所以这些公司推动自己创新的理由更少。空格处的词必须表示“促使人行动的理由”。

approach_en: The first sentence lists three things sustainable farming must balance: ecological, financial and human. The second says consumers look only at the first, but sustainable agriculture "also" covers the other two: economic viability and social well-being. The missing word must mean "includes".
approach_zh: 第一句列出了可持续农业必须兼顾的三个方面：生态、经济和人。第二句说消费者只盯着第一个方面，而可持续农业“还”涵盖另外两个方面：经济上的可行性和社会福祉。空格处的词必须表示“包括”。

approach_en: The passage has two sentences but three moves. First it introduces an older technique, IGS. Then it says how a later team changed it: by combining it with expansion microscopy to make ExIGS. Last it gives the gain: the same abilities "without the limitations on spatial resolution" of IGS.
approach_zh: 文章只有两句话，却包含三步。先介绍一种较早的技术 IGS；再说明后来的团队是怎样改进它的：把它与膨胀显微术结合，形成 ExIGS；最后给出改进带来的好处：具备同样的功能，却“没有 IGS 固有的空间分辨率限制”。

approach_en: Sentence 1 gives the usual method: measuring carbon uptake (GPP) with flux towers on site. Sentence 2 gives its limit ("flux towers aren't evenly distributed globally") and a possible answer: measuring a substitute, SIF, from satellites. Sentence 3 says how promising it is. The passage discusses an indirect, remote method that may make up for the weakness of the standard one.
approach_zh: 第1句介绍了通常的方法：用现场的通量塔测量植物吸收碳的速率（GPP）。第2句指出了它的局限（“通量塔在全球分布不均”）以及一种可能的对策：用卫星测量替代指标 SIF。第3句说明了这种对策的前景。这段文字讨论的是一种间接的遥感方法，它也许能弥补标准方法的不足。

approach_en: The underlined claim in Text 1 is that the honor "is well known among both residents of the city and tourists who visit". Text 2 says the opposite about visitors: without promotion, many "may not even be aware" of Mérida's special food. So the author of Text 2 would doubt that visitors know.
approach_zh: 文本1中画线的说法是：这项荣誉“在本市居民和来访的游客中都广为人知”。文本2对游客的说法正相反：如果不作宣传，许多人“甚至可能不知道”梅里达有独特的美食。所以文本2的作者会怀疑游客是否真的知道。

approach_en: The underlined part of Text 1 reports that some musicians and critics found the whoop "irritating". Text 2 begins by agreeing ("could be annoying") and then turns with "But": it "could also be genuinely fun or even moving". The response must contain both the agreement and the "but".
approach_zh: 文本1的画线部分说，一些音乐人和乐评人觉得这种唱法“让人厌烦”。文本2一开头先表示同意（“可能很烦人”），然后用 But 一转：它“也可以真的很有趣，甚至很动人”。正确的回应必须既有认同，又有转折。

approach_en: The last sentence carries the comparison that the main idea needs. Malta's stone tools were "fairly rudimentary" (simple). In that, they were like tools from Sardinia at the same time ("contemporaneous") but unlike the "sophisticated" tools of nearby Sicily. So Malta was simple, not alone in being simple, and behind Sicily.
approach_zh: 最后一句给出了主旨所需要的比较。马耳他的石器“相当简陋”（rudimentary）。在这一点上，它们与同时期（contemporaneous）撒丁岛的石器相似，却不同于邻近的西西里岛那些“精密”的石器。所以，马耳他的石器简单，但并非唯一简单的，而且落后于西西里。

approach_en: The question asks why he chose ornithology in particular. The reason follows the semicolon: "there was something so dignified and ... scientific about a science that called the sparrow Passer domesticus". It is the Latin names for birds that attract him.
approach_zh: 题目问的是他为什么偏偏选了鸟类学。原因就在分号后面：“这门把麻雀称作 Passer domesticus 的科学，有一种庄重而又……很科学的味道”。吸引他的是鸟类的拉丁学名。

approach_en: Line up the dates. The Bantu expansion began about 4,000 to 5,000 years ago. The assertion is that farming drove it. If so, farming must have existed in the homeland at that time. A finding that the first clear evidence of farming there is much later would challenge the assertion.
approach_zh: 把年代对一对。班图扩张大约开始于4,000至5,000年前。那个说法认为是农业推动了这场扩张。如果真是这样，当时故乡地区就必须已经有农业。如果发现当地最早的确凿农业证据要晚得多，就会对这个说法构成挑战。

approach_en: The passage accepts that the novel is autobiographical but warns that "much of the novel is pure invention". Readers who forget this and look only for links to the author's life miss what he invented, that is, his creativity.
approach_zh: 文章承认这部小说带有自传性，但提醒说“小说的很大一部分纯属虚构”。忘记这一点、只顾寻找小说与作者生平对应之处的读者，会看不到他虚构的部分，也就是他的创造力。

approach_en: After "whereas", the subject is "disyllabic words in which the unstressed syllable follows the stressed one (such as "flourish")" and the verb is "are classified". The parenthesis must close, and then the subject goes straight to its verb with no other mark.
approach_zh: whereas 之后，主语是“disyllabic words in which the unstressed syllable follows the stressed one (such as “flourish”)”，谓语是“are classified”。括号必须收尾，收尾之后主语直接接谓语，不再加别的标点。

approach_en: Máté took many photographs, so the title "Fisherman's Dock" is needed to say which one is meant: it follows "photograph" with no punctuation. The whole phrase "Olga Máté's photograph "Fisherman's Dock"" is the subject of "offers".
approach_zh: Máté 拍过很多照片，要靠标题“Fisherman's Dock”说明是哪一张，所以标题直接跟在 photograph 后面，不加标点。“Olga Máté's photograph “Fisherman's Dock””整体是 offers 的主语。

approach_en: "When Rubasingham was announced" marks a moment in the past. The rest describes what was already going on at that moment: leadership was "increasingly" corporate, with "a growing number" of venues "experimenting". A change in progress at a past moment takes the past progressive.
approach_zh: “When Rubasingham was announced”标出了过去的一个时间点。后面描述的是当时已经在进行的情况：管理层“越来越”公司化，“越来越多的”剧院“正在尝试”新模式。在过去某个时间点正在进行的变化，用过去进行时。

approach_en: The sentence lists three units, and each comes with a short description after a comma: "the khefa, a unit of length", "the khar, a unit of volume", "the sa, a unit of area". Commas stay inside each item; semicolons separate the items.
approach_zh: 句子列举了三个单位，每个单位后面都用逗号带出一个简短的说明：“the khefa, a unit of length”“the khar, a unit of volume”“the sa, a unit of area”。逗号用在每一项内部，分号用在项与项之间。

approach_en: The blank needs a possessive pointing back to "the rational narratives" of the first sentence: in the place of those narratives there are now other stories. "Narratives" is plural, so the word is "their".
approach_zh: 空格处需要一个所有格，指回上一句的“the rational narratives”（理性叙事）：取代这些叙事的是另一类故事。narratives 是复数，所以用 their。

approach_en: Two authors each wrote his own novel: Chesnutt wrote one, Dunbar the other. When two people each own a different thing, each name takes its own apostrophe and s. One shared apostrophe would mean they wrote the novels together.
approach_zh: 两位作者各写了一部小说：Chesnutt 写了一部，Dunbar 写了另一部。两个人各自拥有不同的东西时，每个名字后面都要加撇号和 s。如果只在后一个名字上加，就表示这些小说是两人合著的。

approach_en: The first sentence ends with an obstacle: researchers could not measure the shrimp's tiny, fast movements accurately. The second says what they did because of that obstacle: they turned to computer simulations. The transition must name the obstacle as the reason.
approach_zh: 第一句以一个障碍结尾：研究者无法准确测量这种虾微小而迅速的动作。第二句说的是他们因为这个障碍而采取的做法：改用计算机模拟。过渡语必须指明这个障碍就是原因。
