approach_en: The first sentence says the painter used "several artistic techniques". The second picks out one of them, chiaroscuro, as especially worth noticing. Going from several things to one of them calls for "in particular".
approach_zh: 第一句说这位画家运用了“几种艺术技法”。第二句从中挑出一种（明暗对比法），说它尤其值得注意。从“好几种”说到“其中一种”，要用“in particular”（尤其是）。

approach_en: The first sentence mentions self-portraits in the gallery, where the artist and the subject are the same person. The words after the blank say that in most of the gallery's portraits the subject is someone other than the artist. So self-portraits are unusual cases there. The missing words must say so and lead into the explanation after the colon.
approach_zh: 第一句提到这家美术馆里有自画像，也就是画家和画中人是同一个人。空格之后说，馆中大多数肖像的画中人并不是作画的画家。所以自画像在那里属于少见的情况。空格处的内容必须说明这一点，并引出冒号后面的解释。

approach_en: Sentence 2 is about humans: working in teams did not make them better at the puzzle. Sentence 3 is about ants: working as a colony made them succeed where no single ant could. The two results are opposite, so a word meaning "on the other side" is needed.
approach_zh: 第2句讲的是人：组成团队并没有让人更善于解决这个难题。第3句讲的是蚂蚁：作为蚁群一起行动，使它们解决了任何一只蚂蚁都无法单独解决的问题。两个结果正相反，所以需要一个表示“反过来”的词。

approach_en: The goal is to contrast how shear (here, stirring) affects each substance. The notes say oobleck becomes thicker when stirred and fruit jam becomes thinner. The right choice must give both effects and nothing that is wrong or off the point.
approach_zh: 目标是对比剪切作用（这里指搅拌）对两种物质的影响。笔记说 oobleck 搅拌后变稠，果酱搅拌后变稀。正确选项必须把两种效果都说出来，并且不能有错误或偏题的内容。

approach_en: The goal is a difference between the two uses. Both print unusual shapes with FDM printers. The difference in the notes is what gets printed: Barilla prints pasta dough, which is food, and Kasko prints silicone molds for cakes, which are not food.
approach_zh: 目标是两种用途之间的一个差别。两者都用 FDM 打印机打印出独特的形状。笔记里的差别在于打印的是什么：Barilla 打印的是意大利面的面团，是食物；Kasko 打印的是烤蛋糕用的硅胶模具，不是食物。

approach_en: Clara and Fairman have just complained that Lord Arthur speaks ill of everyone. Lady Venom answers: "we should make allowance. Lord Arthur is a wit and a poet." To "make allowance" is to excuse. She is offering his being a wit and a poet as a reason for the way he talks. The others then refuse that excuse.
approach_zh: Clara 和 Fairman 刚刚抱怨 Lord Arthur 对谁都出言中伤。Lady Venom 回答说：“我们应该体谅他。Lord Arthur 是个才子，又是诗人。”“make allowance”就是原谅、体谅。她把他是才子和诗人当作他这样说话的理由提了出来，而另外两人随后并不接受这个理由。

approach_en: The first sentence after the introduction says the Mole now sees the frightening wood "in a very different way". The next sentence explains why: the snow is hiding the holes, traps and other dangers under "a bright blanket". The main idea joins the change to its cause.
approach_zh: 引言之后的第一句说，鼹鼠现在“以完全不同的眼光”看这片曾经吓人的树林。下一句解释了原因：雪正把坑洞、陷阱等危险盖在“一条明亮的毯子”下面。主旨要把这个变化和它的原因连起来。

approach_en: Put each choice in place of "breathes": "him whose name ___ valor and life and courage to the people". The words "to the people" show that something passes from the name to the people. A name that gives the people valor and courage "imparts" them.
approach_zh: 把每个选项代入 breathes 的位置：“他的名字把英勇、生命和勇气 ___ 给人民”。“to the people”表明有东西从这个名字传到了人们那里。一个名字给人民带来英勇和勇气，就是把它们“赋予”人民。

approach_en: The sentence opens with a describing phrase, "Mounted on a telescope in Chile". Ask: what is mounted on the telescope? The instrument (the spectrograph). The thing described must come right after the comma, as the subject.
approach_zh: 句子以一个修饰短语开头：“Mounted on a telescope in Chile”（安装在智利的一台望远镜上）。要问：安装在望远镜上的是什么？是那台仪器（光谱仪）。被修饰的对象必须紧跟在逗号后面作主语。

approach_en: "These massive structures were used to heat clay mixtures to temperatures of up to 230 degrees Celsius" is a complete sentence. "Such intense heat produced chemical effects ..." is another, closely related one. A semicolon can join two complete, closely related sentences.
approach_zh: “These massive structures were used to heat clay mixtures to temperatures of up to 230 degrees Celsius”是完整的句子；“such intense heat produced chemical effects ...”是另一个与之密切相关的完整句子。分号可以连接两个关系密切的完整句子。

approach_en: Work from the end. "Experiences" belong to the protagonists, and there are two of them (Catherine and Emily), so "protagonists'" is plural possessive. The protagonists belong to the novels, and there are two novels, so "novels'" is plural possessive too.
approach_zh: 从后往前推。experiences 属于主人公，而主人公有两位（Catherine 和 Emily），所以用复数所有格 protagonists'。主人公又属于小说，小说有两部，所以也用复数所有格 novels'。

approach_en: The sentence calls the practice a "juxtaposition" and then describes it after the colon: sleek modern elements and traditional natural materials "in a single design". Putting two different kinds of things together into one whole is a combining. The missing word must mean "combination".
approach_zh: 句子把这种做法称为“并置”，冒号后面接着作了描述：光洁的现代元素和传统的天然材料出现在“同一个设计中”。把两类不同的东西合成一个整体，就是结合。空格处的词必须表示“结合、融合”。

approach_en: The claim has three parts: the quotation must use figurative language (a comparison, not a plain statement), and it must connect two places: Washington, DC, and the rural South of the narrator's past.
approach_zh: 这个说法有三个要点：引文必须使用比喻性的语言（是比较，而不是直白的陈述），并且要把两个地方联系起来：华盛顿，以及叙述者过去生活过的南方乡村。

approach_en: After the blank comes a list of three items separated by semicolons, and each item has the pattern "distance, planet". The words before the blank form a complete statement, so a colon must introduce the list, and the first item must keep the same pattern as the others.
approach_zh: 空格后面是用分号隔开的三项并列内容，每一项的格式都是“距离 + 逗号 + 行星”。空格之前已经是完整的句子，所以要用冒号引出这个列举，并且第一项的格式要和后两项一致。

approach_en: The subject is "interactive features", plural. The part between the dashes gives an example of such a feature and does not change the subject. A plural subject needs a plural verb, and the sentence needs a complete verb.
approach_zh: 主语是“interactive features”，复数。破折号之间的部分是这类功能的一个例子，不改变主语。复数主语要用复数形式的动词，而且句子需要一个完整的谓语动词。

approach_en: King says people on both sides of her family "had repeatedly demonstrated an independent streak", and the rest of the passage gives what they did: they worked hard and "bucked convention". They showed their independence by how they lived. "Demonstrated" here means showed.
approach_zh: King 说她父母两边的家人“一再 demonstrated 出一种独立的个性”，后面的内容说明了他们的所作所为：埋头苦干，并且“不守常规”。他们用自己的生活方式表现出了独立。这里的 demonstrated 意思是“表现出”。

approach_en: The result clause tells you what the English text does: "so readers who aren't familiar with Spanish can easily read the story". If readers who know no Spanish can still follow, the English around the Spanish words must hint at what they mean. The missing word must mean "indicates".
approach_zh: 表示结果的分句告诉我们英文部分起了什么作用：“所以不熟悉西班牙语的读者也能轻松读懂这个故事”。如果不懂西班牙语的读者也能跟上，那么西班牙语词语周围的英文一定是在暗示它们的意思。空格处的词必须表示“暗示、表明”。

approach_en: The words after the semicolon explain the blank: the staff "consulted numerous sources to ensure the accuracy of the displays". Research done carefully and thoroughly has a quality that the missing word names.
approach_zh: 分号后面的话解释了空格处的词：馆方人员“查阅了大量资料，以确保展品的准确性”。做得仔细而周密的研究所具备的品质，就是空格处的词。

approach_en: The first sentence states the claim: Clara Peeters "played a crucial role in the history of still-life painting". The rest supports it: she painted such subjects before the genre even had a name, and her influence was so strong that similar painters were linked to her "circle".
approach_zh: 第一句提出论断：Clara Peeters 在静物画的历史上“起了关键作用”。后面的内容都是支撑：这种体裁连名称都还没有的时候她就在画这类题材；她的影响大到画类似题材的画家会被归入她的“圈子”。

approach_en: Line up the facts. Native plants need fruit-eating birds to spread their seeds. The native birds that did this are extinct. Birds brought to the island in the last 150 years now spread seeds. So the native plants may now rely on these newer birds.
approach_zh: 把事实排一排。本地植物需要食果鸟类来传播种子；过去做这件事的本地鸟类已经灭绝；最近150年引入岛上的鸟类如今在传播种子。所以，本地植物现在可能要依靠这些后来的鸟。

approach_en: The sentence is a statement, not a question: "Though they are in different countries, the towns ... do have something in common." The subject "the towns" is already there, so it must not be repeated as "they", and a statement ends with a period.
approach_zh: 这是一个陈述句，不是疑问句：“Though they are in different countries, the towns ... do have something in common.”主语 the towns 已经出现，不能再用 they 重复；陈述句以句号结尾。

approach_en: The subject is "This ongoing transfer", singular. "Of species between hemispheres" only describes the transfer. The verb must be singular, and "now" calls for the present tense.
approach_zh: 主语是“This ongoing transfer”，单数。“of species between hemispheres”只是在修饰 transfer。谓语用单数，句中的 now 要求用现在时。

approach_en: This sentence is turned around: the verb comes before its subject. Put it in normal order: "The locative case is among several noun cases ...". The subject is "the locative case", singular, so the verb is "is".
approach_zh: 这是一个倒装句，动词在主语之前。把它还原成正常语序：“The locative case is among several noun cases ...”。主语是“the locative case”，单数，所以动词用 is。

approach_en: "A second ancestor" is a general phrase, and "mexicana" is the name that says which ancestor. A colon after a complete statement can introduce that name. Then "a highland subspecies of teosinte" describes mexicana, so a comma follows the name.
approach_zh: “a second ancestor”是泛指，后面的 mexicana 说明这个祖先具体是谁。前面是完整的句子，可以用冒号引出这个名称；“a highland subspecies of teosinte ...”又是对 mexicana 的补充说明，所以名称后面用逗号。

approach_en: The second sentence makes a general statement: the World Cup "used to be much smaller and more limited geographically". The third gives one case that shows it: in 1930 there were only 13 teams, all from two regions. A general statement followed by a case calls for "for example".
approach_zh: 第二句作了一般性的陈述：世界杯“过去规模小得多，地域范围也更有限”。第三句给出了一个能说明这一点的实例：1930年只有13支球队，而且全部来自两个地区。先概括、再举实例，要用“for example”。

approach_en: The goal is to define a term, "epistolary novel". A definition says what kind of thing it is in general. The notes supply one: such novels are "written primarily as a series of fictional documents", which can be "letters, journal entries, newspaper clippings, and more". Sentences about one particular novel are examples, not definitions.
approach_zh: 目标是给“书信体小说”（epistolary novel）这个术语下定义。定义要说明这类事物一般是什么。笔记提供了定义：这类小说“主要以一系列虚构的文件写成”，这些文件可以是“书信、日记、剪报等”。讲某一部具体小说的句子是例子，不是定义。

approach_en: The first sentence says what the students do: they learn to use techniques from the arts, such as slowing down and considering several points of view. The second says what they gain by doing it: better skills of observation. The transition must mean "by doing that".
approach_zh: 第一句说的是学生们做什么：学习运用艺术领域的方法，比如放慢解读的速度、从多个角度考虑。第二句说的是他们这样做得到了什么：更好的观察能力。过渡语的意思必须是“通过这样做”。

approach_en: The words after the comma explain the blank: such documentaries offer "stories without any depth". Work done with little care or thought, only on the surface, is described by the missing word. The second sentence presents a film with real depth as "a refreshing contrast".
approach_zh: 逗号后面的话解释了空格处的词：这类纪录片“讲的故事毫无深度”。不用心、只做表面文章的作品，就是空格处的词所形容的。第二句把一部真正有深度的影片作为“令人耳目一新的对比”提了出来。

approach_en: "While" sets two groups against each other. Polar and temperate species are "highly dispersed across the morphological spectrum": spread over many body shapes. Tropical species must be the opposite: gathered within one kind of shape, the deep-bodied forms. The missing words must mean "gathered among".
approach_zh: While 把两类鱼对照起来。极地和温带的物种“在形态谱上高度分散”，也就是分布在许多种体形上。热带物种则必然相反：集中在一类体形上，即体高较大的形态。空格处的词语必须表示“集中在……之中”。

approach_en: The colon introduces the evidence: people's eyes "looked at where the target ball would have gone if the ball that altered its path did not exist". They were picturing something that did not happen, a "what if" situation contrary to the facts. The missing word names that kind of situation.
approach_zh: 冒号引出了证据：人们的眼睛“看向了假如那个改变其路径的球不存在，目标球本来会去的地方”。他们在设想一件并没有发生的事，一种与事实相反的“假如”情形。空格处的词指的就是这种情形。

approach_en: Take the sentences one at a time. Sentence 1 introduces a work and calls it Linebarger's "most significant": a 1940s Army guide on propaganda. Sentence 2 gives one of its ideas: propaganda should be as appealing as popular films. Sentence 3 widens the view: the work shaped the US approach to promoting its interests, which still draws on pop culture.
approach_zh: 逐句来看。第1句介绍了一部作品，并称它是 Linebarger“最重要的”作品：20世纪40年代的一份关于宣传的美国陆军指南。第2句给出了其中的一个观点：宣传应当像流行电影一样吸引人。第3句把视野放宽：这部作品塑造了美国推广国家利益的方式，这种方式至今仍从流行文化中汲取灵感。

approach_en: Text 1 praises Meng's study: by separating the roots while letting fungal strands through, it "excluded all pathways other than the CMN". Text 2 agrees the roots had to be separated but adds a problem: a barrier that lets fungal threads through also lets liquids through, so other pathways were not excluded. Text 2 therefore thinks Text 1 gives the method too much credit.
approach_zh: 文本1称赞 Meng 的研究：用屏障把根系隔开、同时让真菌丝穿过，从而“排除了菌根网络（CMN）以外的所有途径”。文本2同意必须把根系隔开，但指出一个问题：能让真菌丝穿过的屏障，液体也能穿过，所以其他途径并没有被排除。因此文本2认为文本1把这种方法说得太好了。

approach_en: Find the subject and its verb. The subject is "Roger Angell's reputation as one of the greatest baseball writers of all time" and the verb is "has perhaps overshadowed". Between them sits a description, "bolstered by ... the game", which already ends with a comma. It needs a comma at its start too, and no second verb may be added.
approach_zh: 先找主语和谓语。主语是“Roger Angell's reputation as one of the greatest baseball writers of all time”，谓语是“has perhaps overshadowed”。两者之间插入了一个修饰成分“bolstered by ... the game”，它的结尾已经有逗号，开头也要有逗号与之配对，而且不能再添一个谓语动词。

approach_en: Check both sides of the blank. "Contrast Panama with the Netherlands, which ceased to be part of the empire in 1648" is a complete sentence (a command). "The latter's connection to the empire is so attenuated that ..." is another complete sentence, and it explains the contrast. A colon fits.
approach_zh: 看空格两边。“Contrast Panama with the Netherlands, which ceased to be part of the empire in 1648”是一个完整的祈使句；“the latter's connection to the empire is so attenuated that ...”也是完整的句子，并且解释了为什么要作这个对比，所以用冒号。

approach_en: The first sentence describes a process: samples were collected and then analyzed by OSL dating. The second gives what came out at the end of that process: the tools were about 400,000 years old. The transition must mark a final result.
approach_zh: 第一句描述了一个过程：采集样本，然后用 OSL 测年法分析。第二句给出了这个过程最后得到的结果：这些工具大约有40万年的历史。过渡词必须表示“最终的结果”。

approach_en: The first sentence gives a fact: Lysithea orbits in the same direction as Jupiter rotates. The second gives the name that follows from that fact: its orbit is called prograde. A fact followed by what it leads to calls for a word such as "thus".
approach_zh: 第一句给出一个事实：Lysithea 的公转方向与木星的自转方向相同。第二句给出由这个事实而来的名称：它的轨道被称为顺行轨道。先讲事实、再讲由此得出的结论，要用 thus 这类词。

approach_en: Compare the two distances. The JWST is almost one million miles beyond Earth's orbit. The Hubble is only about 340 miles above Earth's surface. The second fact differs sharply from the first, so the transition must mark contrast.
approach_zh: 比较两个距离。詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜在地球轨道之外近一百万英里处；哈勃望远镜离地球表面只有大约340英里。后一个事实与前一个差别极大，所以过渡词必须表示对比。

approach_en: The second sentence says Nauruan is also spoken in New York City. The third says exactly where in the city: the Murray Hill neighborhood of Manhattan. Moving from a general place to an exact one calls for "specifically".
approach_zh: 第二句说纽约市也有人说瑙鲁语。第三句说明了具体在纽约的什么地方：曼哈顿的 Murray Hill 街区。从大致的地点说到确切的地点，要用 specifically（具体来说）。

approach_en: The goal has two parts: say whom the award is named for, and name one person who received it. From the notes: it is named after Alan Turing, and Barbara Liskov won it in 2008. The right choice must contain both names.
approach_zh: 目标有两部分：说明这个奖是以谁的名字命名的，并指出一位获奖者。从笔记可知：它以 Alan Turing 的名字命名，Barbara Liskov 在2008年获奖。正确选项必须同时包含这两个名字。

approach_en: "Mere" means "nothing more than". The girl "took comfort in the mere presence of the chair in the room": she was comforted by nothing more than the chair being there. The phrase points to the plain fact that the chair exists in the room.
approach_zh: mere 的意思是“仅仅、不过是”。女孩“从椅子在房间里这件事本身得到了安慰”：让她感到安慰的不过是椅子在那里而已。这个短语指的是椅子存在于房间里这个简单的事实。

approach_en: "Initially" in the first sentence and "However ... gradually drew in customers" in the second mark a change. At first diners did not accept the chains; later marketing won them over, and "public opinion had changed". The missing word must describe the unwilling first reaction.
approach_zh: 第一句的 initially（起初）和第二句的“However ... 逐渐吸引了顾客”标出了一个变化。起初食客并不接受这些连锁店；后来营销手段赢得了他们，“公众的看法发生了改变”。空格处的词必须描述最初那种不情愿的反应。

approach_en: Two phrases describe the same thing as the blank: "a period of flourishing literary production" before it and "this flood of interesting writing" after it. Both mean a very large amount. The missing word must mean "plenty".
approach_zh: 有两个短语与空格处的词说的是同一件事：前面的“文学创作繁荣的时期”和后面的“这股有趣作品的洪流”。两者都表示数量很大。空格处的词必须表示“大量、丰富”。

approach_en: The second sentence, built on "whereas", describes two different patterns: in active regions bursts of light come before drops in magnetic energy; in quiet regions the two stay linked with no such drops. The two kinds of region behave differently. The missing word must mean "difference".
approach_zh: 第二句以 whereas 为轴，描述了两种不同的模式：在活动区，紫外光爆发出现在磁能下降之前；在宁静区，两者一直保持关联，没有这样的下降。两类区域的表现不同。空格处的词必须表示“差异”。

approach_en: The underlined words come after a colon that follows "both inventors exemplified important traits that continue to drive innovation". So they are the list of those traits: qualities of the two inventors (not of their machines) that inventors still depend on.
approach_zh: 画线的词语出现在冒号之后，冒号前面是“两位发明者都体现了至今仍在推动创新的重要品质”。所以画线部分就是这些品质的清单：是两位发明者（而不是她们的机器）身上的品质，也是今天的发明者仍然依靠的品质。

approach_en: The first two sentences give the plan and its usual success: prices ending in 9 are meant to look like good value, and "in many cases" shoppers take them that way. The underlined sentence, beginning "However", adds that "some consumers" react against them, seeing lower quality or a trick. So it shows that the method does not always work.
approach_zh: 前两句讲了这种做法的意图和通常的效果：以9结尾的价格是为了让商品显得划算，而“在许多情况下”，顾客也确实这样看。画线句以 However 开头，补充说“有些消费者”的反应正相反，觉得这意味着质量差，甚至觉得是在误导人。所以它说明这种方法并不是每次都奏效。

approach_en: Maria and Surface have just complained that Sir Benjamin speaks ill of everyone. Lady Sneerwell answers: "we should make allowance. Sir Benjamin is a wit and a poet." To "make allowance" is to excuse. She is offering his being a wit and a poet as a reason for the way he talks. The others then refuse that excuse.
approach_zh: Maria 和 Surface 刚刚抱怨 Sir Benjamin 对谁都出言中伤。Lady Sneerwell 回答说：“我们应该体谅他。Sir Benjamin 是个才子，又是诗人。”“make allowance”就是原谅、体谅。她把他是才子和诗人当作他这样说话的理由提了出来，而另外两人随后并不接受这个理由。

approach_en: "Although" marks the turn: gardeners see chickweed as a nuisance, but "weeds like it can offer certain advantages". The example that follows (less soil erosion) supports that statement, so that statement is the main idea.
approach_zh: Although 标出了转折：园丁把繁缕看作讨厌的东西，但“像它这样的杂草也能带来某些好处”。后面的例子（减少水土流失）是在支持这句话，所以这句话就是主旨。

approach_en: Ask what every sentence is about. Sentence 1 defines division of labor, sentences 2 and 3 show how it works, and sentences 4 and 5 give its results: more skill, less lost time, more goods. The focus is how this system makes production more efficient.
approach_zh: 看每一句都在讲什么。第1句给劳动分工下定义，第2、3句说明它怎样运作，第4、5句给出结果：更熟练、更省时间、产量更高。全文的焦点是这种制度如何提高生产效率。

approach_en: The first sentence of the story text says the Mole now sees the frightening wood "in a very different way". The next sentence explains why: the snow is hiding the holes, traps and other dangers under "a bright blanket". The main idea joins the change to its cause.
approach_zh: 故事正文的第一句说，鼹鼠现在“以完全不同的眼光”看这片曾经吓人的树林。下一句解释了原因：雪正把坑洞、陷阱等危险盖在“一条明亮的毯子”下面。主旨要把这个变化和它的原因连起来。

approach_en: The conclusion has two halves, and the data must cover both. Half one: the researchers' model "maximized profit", so its total profit is the highest. Half two: it may not suit firms that must keep "cash outflows" (costs) low, so its total cost is higher than that of another model. Check the table: profit 11,344,003 is the highest, and cost 30,933,469 is above the 30,528,134 of the other two.
approach_zh: 结论有两层意思，数据要把两层都覆盖到。第一层：研究者提出的模型“利润最大”，所以它的总利润最高。第二层：它可能不适合需要尽量减少现金流出（即成本）的公司，所以它的总成本比别的模型高。对照表格：它的利润11,344,003是最高的，成本30,933,469高于另外两个模型的30,528,134。

approach_en: The claim is that Archer's social circle values "the familiar more than the new". The right quotation must show a choice between something old and something new, with the old one preferred.
approach_zh: 这个说法是：Archer 所在的社交圈“看重熟悉的东西胜过新的东西”。正确的引文必须出现新旧之间的选择，并且人们选了旧的。

approach_en: The researcher's claim is that the ten-year-old survey does not show what today's residents think. The passage names what affects willingness to walk: weather and "well-enforced low speed limits for cars". Support would be one of those factors having changed in the neighborhood since the survey.
approach_zh: 研究者的说法是：十年前的调查不能准确反映今天居民的想法。文中指出了影响步行意愿的因素：天气，以及“对汽车严格执行的低限速”。能支持这个说法的，是其中某个因素在调查之后在这个街区发生了变化。

approach_en: Match the languages on both sides. In New York, Mandarin dominates in Flushing, and Cantonese and Fuzhounese dominate in Chinatown. In China, Mandarin is the language of the north, and Cantonese and Fuzhounese are languages of the south. So people from the north probably settle in Flushing and people from the south in Chinatown.
approach_zh: 把两边的语言对应起来。在纽约，法拉盛以普通话为主，唐人街以粤语和福州话为主。在中国，普通话通行于北方，粤语和福州话通行于南方。所以，来自北方的人很可能在法拉盛落脚，来自南方的人很可能在唐人街落脚。

approach_en: The musicians had far more noise exposure and chose louder volumes, so one might guess that their hearing was damaged and they needed more volume. "However" removes that guess: the two groups had "clinically similar hearing". So the difference in volume does not come from hearing loss caused by noise.
approach_zh: 音乐人接触噪声多得多，选择的音量也更大，人们可能会猜想他们的听力受损了，所以需要更大的音量。However 否定了这种猜想：两组人的听力“在临床上相近”。所以，音量上的差异并不是噪声造成的听力损失引起的。

approach_en: The clause "when it was introduced in 1911" fixes the time in the past. The reaction of the public happened at that same past time, so the verb is the simple past.
approach_zh: 从句“when it was introduced in 1911”把时间定在了过去。公众的反应发生在同一个过去的时间，所以用一般过去时。

approach_en: The missing verb belongs to "which", and "which" stands for "This invisible border". A border is one thing, so the verb is singular. The sentence describes how things are now, so the present tense fits.
approach_zh: 空格处的动词属于 which 引导的从句，而 which 指代的是“This invisible border”。边界是一个事物，动词用单数。句子描述的是现在的情况，用现在时。

approach_en: The sentence opens with a describing phrase, "Originally introduced in 2017 and later optimized for faster object detection". Ask: what was introduced and then optimized? The RetinaNet algorithm. It must come right after the comma, as the subject.
approach_zh: 句子以一个修饰短语开头：“Originally introduced in 2017 and later optimized for faster object detection”（最初于2017年提出，后来为更快的目标检测作了优化）。要问：被提出、后来又被优化的是什么？是 RetinaNet 算法。它必须紧跟在逗号后面作主语。

approach_en: The part before the blank ("Although ..., the handfish's unusual locomotion is actually a specialized adaptation for moving along the seafloor") is a complete sentence. What follows ("the handfish's modified pectoral fins function much like legs ...") is also complete, and it explains the adaptation. Use a colon.
approach_zh: 空格之前“Although ..., the handfish's unusual locomotion is actually a specialized adaptation for moving along the seafloor”是完整的句子，空格之后“the handfish's modified pectoral fins function much like legs ...”也是完整的句子，并且解释了这种适应具体是什么，所以用冒号。

approach_en: Two possessives are needed. The access belongs to the analysts (many of them): "analysts'". The data belong to the countries, and the next sentence speaks of "countries' labor conditions", so there are several countries: "countries'".
approach_zh: 这里需要两个所有格。access 属于分析人员（不止一位），用 analysts'。data 属于各个国家，下一句说的是“countries' labor conditions”，可见国家不止一个，用 countries'。

approach_en: Two times of day are described in order. "At dawn", when the air is cool, the iguana rests in the sun. "As the day becomes hotter", it moves into shade. The second time comes after the first, so the transition is "later".
approach_zh: 文章按先后描述了一天中的两个时段。“黎明时”空气还凉，鬣蜥在阳光下休息；“随着天气变热”，它转到阴凉处。后一个时段在前一个之后，所以过渡词用 later。

approach_en: The first sentence says poisonous amphibians move safely "during the day". The second explains what protects them in daylight: "with the sun overhead", predators can see their warning colors. The transition should point back to the time just named, the daytime.
approach_zh: 第一句说有毒的两栖动物“在白天”安全地活动。第二句解释了白天是什么在保护它们：“太阳当头”，捕食者看得见它们的警戒色。过渡语应当指回刚才提到的时间，也就是白天。

approach_en: The first sentence makes a general statement: this anthology "includes generous selections from each poet". The second names two poets who each have several poems in it. A general statement followed by particular cases calls for "for example".
approach_zh: 第一句作了一般性的陈述：这本选集“为每位诗人收录了较多的作品”。第二句点出了两位各有多首诗入选的诗人。先概括、再举具体情况，要用“for example”。

approach_en: The first sentence describes one way of judging: counting points, so that a contest "can be measured numerically". The second describes traditional Muay Thai, where the winner is decided "not by a point total ... but by an overall evaluation". The second way is the opposite of the first.
approach_zh: 第一句描述了一种评判方式：计点，使比赛“可以用数字来衡量”。第二句描述的是传统泰拳，那里决定胜负的“不是各个动作的点数之和，而是对整体表现的评价”。第二种方式与第一种正相反。

approach_en: The goal is a similarity between the two plants. They harm ecosystems in different ways and came to the US in different ways. What they share is the first note's point: each is a nonnative species that causes harm, so each is "considered invasive".
approach_zh: 目标是两种植物的一个相似之处。它们危害生态系统的方式不同，传入美国的途径也不同。共同点在于第一条笔记所说的：两者都是造成危害的外来物种，所以都“被视为入侵物种”。

approach_en: The goal is a specific example of one kind of urban natural area. The notes name one kind: home gardens, defined as "private gardens on residential properties throughout a city". The right choice must name that kind.
approach_zh: 目标是举出一种城市自然区域的具体例子。笔记里提到了其中一种：家庭花园，定义是“遍布城市住宅用地上的私人花园”。正确选项必须说出这一种。

approach_en: The goal is a similarity between two songs. "Thula Bane" is on Khumalo's 1962 album and "Here Comes the Sun" is on her 1972 album. What the songs share is that both appear on albums by the same singer.
approach_zh: 目标是两首歌的一个相似之处。《Thula Bane》收录在 Khumalo 1962年的专辑里，《Here Comes the Sun》收录在她1972年的专辑里。两首歌的共同点是都出现在同一位歌手的专辑中。

approach_en: Read the second sentence to see whether negative pressure is wanted. It says negative pressure makes fresh air move into the kitchen, "helping contain cooking odors and keep kitchen staff comfortable". Those are good results. So engineers want negative pressure and balance the airflow to produce it.
approach_zh: 读第二句，看负压是不是人们想要的。它说负压会让新鲜空气流进厨房，“有助于把烹饪的气味控制在厨房内，并让厨房工作人员感到舒适”。这些都是好的结果。所以工程师想要负压，他们调节气流就是为了制造负压。

approach_en: The second sentence says what the electrician needs: "This information is necessary" to work out whether one faulty device or too many devices caused the problem. To get that information, the electrician asks tenants to say which devices were in use, one by one. The missing word must mean "list".
approach_zh: 第二句说明了电工需要什么：“这些信息是必要的”，用来判断问题是由某个有故障的设备引起的，还是同时使用的设备太多造成的。为了得到这些信息，电工会让租户一一说出当时在用哪些设备。空格处的词必须表示“列出”。

approach_en: The words after the dash explain the blank: the staff "consulted numerous sources to ensure the accuracy of the displays". Research done carefully and thoroughly has a quality that the missing word names.
approach_zh: 破折号后面的话解释了空格处的词：馆方人员“查阅了大量资料，以确保展品的准确性”。做得仔细而周密的研究所具备的品质，就是空格处的词。

approach_en: The zone "is difficult to access directly", so scientists study it by indirect means. The example shows one: "tracking aquatic organisms found in soil past a river's banks". The organisms stand in for the zone itself. Something measured in place of what cannot be measured directly is what the missing word names.
approach_zh: 这个区域“很难直接进入”，所以科学家用间接的办法来研究它。例子给出了一种办法：“追踪在河岸以外的土壤中发现的水生生物”。这些生物是这个区域本身的替身。测不到的东西用别的东西来代替测量，后者就是空格处的词所指的。

approach_en: Put each choice in place of "breathes": "him whose name ___ valor and life and courage to the people". The words "to the people" show that something passes from the name to the people. A name that gives the people valor and courage "imparts" them.
approach_zh: 把每个选项代入 breathes 的位置：“他的名字把英勇、生命和勇气 ___ 给人民”。“to the people”表明有东西从这个名字传到了人们那里。一个名字给人民带来英勇和勇气，就是把它们“赋予”人民。

approach_en: Take the sentences one at a time. Sentence 1 gives a prediction: trees will spread north as it warms. Sentence 2, with "However", gives evidence against it: many species are not doing so. Sentence 3 gives a reason for the mismatch: too few of the fungi the trees need at the northern edge.
approach_zh: 逐句来看。第1句给出了一个预测：随着气温升高，树木会向北扩散。第2句用 However 给出了与之不符的证据：许多树种并没有这样做。第3句给出了造成这种不符的原因：在分布区的北缘，树木所需的真菌种类太少。

approach_en: The underlined part brings in an expert, Jane Feuer, who saw that ideas taken from film studies "often fell short" for television. The next sentence begins "Recognizing those limits, researchers turned to" new approaches. So Feuer's observation gives the reason scholars changed their methods.
approach_zh: 画线部分引入了一位专家 Jane Feuer 的看法：从电影研究借来的概念用在电视上“往往不够用”。下一句以“认识到这些局限，研究者转向了”新的方法开头。所以 Feuer 的观察说明了学者们改变研究方法的原因。

approach_en: Mercado (Text 1) points out that research has usually looked at people we already know, and shows that contact with strangers also makes people feel good. The model in Text 2 has three circles, and even the outermost holds only people who "count as part of one's social network". Strangers appear nowhere in it. So Mercado would see the model as a sign that research leaves out a kind of contact that matters.
approach_zh: Mercado（文本1）指出，以往的研究通常只关注已经认识的人，而她的研究表明与陌生人的接触同样让人感觉更好。文本2的模型有三个圈，连最外面的一圈装的也只是“算得上自己社交网络一部分”的人，陌生人根本不在其中。所以 Mercado 会认为，这个模型说明研究遗漏了一类重要的交往。

approach_en: The conclusion is that contact with trees changes rainwater's chemistry. The passage gives the baseline for regular rain: 0.90 mg/L of DOC and 0.19 mg/L of TDN. Compare every row of the table with those two numbers. All four samples that touched trees are higher on both measures.
approach_zh: 结论是：与树木接触会改变雨水的化学成分。文中给出了普通雨水的基准值：DOC 为0.90 mg/L，TDN 为0.19 mg/L。把表中每一行都与这两个数字比较：四份接触过树木的样本，两项指标全都更高。

approach_en: The hypothesis compares two ways of using an emoji. The usual negative effect appears when the emoji is added after the text (supplement). The team predicts the effect is smaller when the emoji replaces the word (substitute). The supporting data must therefore compare substitute with supplement. The graph gives about 3.6 for supplement, 4.1 for substitute and 4.2 for control.
approach_zh: 这个假说比较的是使用表情符号的两种方式。表情符号加在文字后面（supplement）时会出现通常的负面效应；研究团队预测，用表情符号替换文字（substitute）时这种效应会减弱。所以支持假说的数据必须是 substitute 与 supplement 的比较。图中三组的平均分大约是：supplement 3.6，substitute 4.1，control 4.2。

approach_en: The underlined sentence is the last one: when cells last a shorter time, the cost gap between plants using new cells and plants using recycled cells widens from 18.8% to 31.3%. A shorter lifetime means cells are replaced more often. The gap grows only if each replacement costs more for new cells than for recycled ones, and the cost named in the passage that differs between them is the cost of getting materials.
approach_zh: 画线句是最后一句：电池寿命缩短后，使用新电池的电站与使用回收电池的电站之间的成本差距，从18.8%扩大到31.3%。寿命缩短意味着更换更频繁。只有当每次更换时新电池比回收电池花费更多，差距才会拉大；而文中提到的、两者有差别的成本正是获取材料的费用。

approach_en: The underlined claim is the general idea: breeds that lived in the Americas before European contact descend from dogs that came with people from Asia in the last ice age. Part of the passage's support for it is the Dixie dingo, whose living members carry a haplotype found only in Northeast Asian dogs. To undermine the claim, find another way the Dixie dingo could have got that haplotype. Recent mixing with imported Northeast Asian dogs would do it, and that evidence would then no longer point to an ancient origin.
approach_zh: 画线的说法是一个总的看法：美洲在与欧洲人接触之前就有的犬种，是末次冰期随人类从亚洲迁来的狗的后代。文中支持这一看法的证据之一是 Dixie dingo：现存个体带有只见于东北亚犬的单倍型。要削弱这个说法，就要找出 Dixie dingo 还可能通过别的途径获得这一单倍型。近代与引进的东北亚犬混血就是这样一条途径，这样一来，这条证据就不再指向古老的起源。

approach_en: Find the size ("scope") of the ecologists' goal: "Increasing stony coral colonies worldwide". The tool has so far been tested with one Indian Ocean coral, using metabolites from Indian Ocean algae. To show it can already serve a worldwide goal, it must work for other species in other oceans.
approach_zh: 先弄清生态学家目标的范围（scope）：“在全世界范围内增加石珊瑚群落”。这个工具目前只用印度洋的一种珊瑚做过测试，用的也是从印度洋藻类提取的代谢物。要说明它已经能够服务于全球性的目标，就必须证明它对其他海域的其他珊瑚种类也有效。

approach_en: Combine three facts. Iced tea brands have short product lines (10.2 products) and cookie brands long ones (24.1). The longer the line, the harder it is for shoppers to judge a brand's quality. In downturns shoppers avoid risk. So in a downturn shoppers are more likely to keep paying extra for a brand they can judge easily: iced tea, not cookies.
approach_zh: 把三个事实合起来看。冰茶品牌的产品线短（平均10.2种产品），饼干品牌的产品线长（24.1种）。产品线越长，消费者越难判断一个品牌的质量。经济低迷时，消费者会规避风险。所以在经济低迷时，消费者更可能继续为容易判断质量的品牌多付钱，那就是冰茶，而不是饼干。

approach_en: Reprinting poems without the poet's control looks strange to us, because we assume one named author controls a work. Yet at the time it "was accepted as routine, even by the poets". If the same practice is normal in one period and odd in another, then what an author is, and what rights go with the role, depend on the setting in which works are written and published.
approach_zh: 不经诗人同意就转载诗歌，在我们看来很奇怪，因为我们默认一部作品由一位署名的作者掌控。可在当时，这种做法“被当作平常事接受，连受影响的诗人也是如此”。同一种做法在一个时期很正常、在另一个时期却显得反常，这说明“作者”是什么、这个身份附带哪些权利，取决于作品写作和发表时所处的环境。

approach_en: The sentence opens with a describing phrase, "Mounted at the prime focus of the Subaru Telescope in Hawaiʻi". Ask: what is mounted there? The instrument (the spectrograph). The thing described must come right after the comma, as the subject.
approach_zh: 句子以一个修饰短语开头：“Mounted at the prime focus of the Subaru Telescope in Hawaiʻi”（安装在夏威夷昴星团望远镜的主焦点上）。要问：安装在那里的是什么？是那台仪器（光谱仪）。被修饰的对象必须紧跟在逗号后面作主语。

approach_en: "A twofold purpose" promises two things, and "celebrating ... and highlighting ..." names them. The words up to "purpose" form a complete sentence, so a colon introduces the two parts, and nothing may come between "celebrating" and its object "the achievements".
approach_zh: “a twofold purpose”（双重目的）预告了后面有两点，“celebrating ... and highlighting ...”正是这两点。到 purpose 为止已经是完整的句子，所以用冒号引出这两部分；celebrating 和它的宾语 the achievements 之间不能有标点。

approach_en: The subject is "courtly entertainment", singular. The list between the dashes ("including cards, dice, and other games ...") gives examples and does not change the subject. The passage is about a past era, so a singular past verb is needed.
approach_zh: 主语是“courtly entertainment”，单数。破折号之间的列举（“including cards, dice, and other games ...”）只是举例，不改变主语。文章讲的是过去的时代，所以需要单数的过去时动词。

approach_en: Find the main verb: "A 1932 report ... was disproved by Roger Bannister's sub-four-minute mile". Since "was disproved" is the main verb, the blank cannot hold another full verb. It needs an "-ing" form describing the report: "a report ... asserting that ...".
approach_zh: 先找谓语：“A 1932 report ... was disproved by Roger Bannister's sub-four-minute mile”。既然 was disproved 已经是谓语，空格处就不能再放一个完整的谓语动词，而需要一个修饰 report 的 -ing 形式：“a report ... asserting that ...”（一份断言……的报告）。

approach_en: Look inside the clause that begins "whose work". Its verb comes much later: "whose work ... encourages a broader rethinking". Since "encourages" is the verb of that clause, the blank needs an "-ing" form describing "work": "work highlighting the richness of Smith's poems".
approach_zh: 看“whose work”引导的这个从句。它的谓语出现在很后面：“whose work ... encourages a broader rethinking”。既然 encourages 是这个从句的谓语，空格处就需要一个修饰 work 的 -ing 形式：“work highlighting the richness of Smith's poems”（凸显 Smith 诗作之丰富的研究）。

approach_en: The first sentence says where the sculpture stands: Millennium Park, an outdoor space. The second says what happens to it: it is exposed to rain, snow, heat and humidity. These things happen to it because of where it is, so the transition should simply point back to the place: "there".
approach_zh: 第一句说明了这件雕塑的位置：千禧公园，一个户外空间。第二句说的是它在那里的遭遇：受到雨、雪、高温和潮湿的侵袭。这些都是因为它所在的地点才发生的，所以过渡词只需指回这个地点：there（在那里）。

approach_en: Follow the comparison. Mintaka is very far away (about 1,400 light-years) and still very bright. Merak is "not as bright as Mintaka" but also ranks in the top 50. The third sentence builds on that by adding the fact behind Merak's rank: it is close, only about 80 light-years away. A sentence that carries the previous point further with a supporting fact takes "indeed".
approach_zh: 顺着比较往下看。Mintaka 非常遥远（约1,400光年），却仍然很亮。Merak“不如 Mintaka 亮”，但也排在前50名之内。第三句在此基础上进一步补充了 Merak 能有这个排名的原因：它离得近，只有大约80光年。用一个事实把上一句的意思再推进一步，过渡词用 indeed（的确，事实上）。

approach_en: Two groups order the branches of a river system in opposite directions. Cartographers start at the lowest point; hydrologists start at the top. Opposite starting points call for a transition of contrast.
approach_zh: 两类人给一个水系的各条支流排序时，方向正相反。制图师从最低点开始，水文学家从最高处开始。起点相反，需要表示对比的过渡语。

approach_en: The second sentence states a goal: the researchers "wanted to determine whether" the wear on the griddle pieces fits the cooking of oily flatbreads. The third describes what they did to reach that goal: an experiment with rebuilt griddles. A goal followed by the action taken to reach it calls for "to that end".
approach_zh: 第二句陈述了一个目标：研究者“想确定”烤盘碎片上的磨损痕迹是否与烹制富含油脂的面饼相符。第三句描述了他们为达到这个目标所做的事：用复原的烤盘做实验。先讲目标、再讲为此采取的行动，要用“to that end”。

approach_en: Lay the notes on a timeline. Manhua was "strongly influenced by manga" from the late 1800s to the late 1980s and kept a structured layout all that time. After 1945, manga began trying panels of different sizes, a change manhua did not copy. From 1947, manhua took on other manga traits. So manhua stayed under manga's influence without following every change.
approach_zh: 把笔记排成时间线。从19世纪末到20世纪80年代末，台湾漫画“深受日本漫画的影响”，这期间一直保持规整的版式。1945年以后，日本漫画开始尝试大小不同的分格，这个变化台湾漫画并没有照搬。从1947年起，台湾漫画又吸收了日本漫画的其他特点。所以，台湾漫画一直处在日本漫画的影响之下，但并没有跟随每一项变化。

approach_en: The goal is to contrast two groups of dog breeds. The notes give the contrast directly: breeds with upright, wolf-like ears can make the "ears rotator" movement, and breeds with drooped ears cannot. The right choice must state both halves correctly.
approach_zh: 目标是对比两类犬种。笔记直接给出了对比：耳朵直立、像狼的犬种能做出“耳朵旋转”这个面部动作，耳朵下垂的犬种做不出来。正确选项必须把这两方面都准确地说出来。

approach_en: The sentence turns on "but": the job "appears to be" one thing, yet "apparent simplicity can mask considerable complexity". "Apparent simplicity" repeats the idea of the blank. So in the guides the job looks simple. The missing word must mean "simple".
approach_zh: 句子以 but 为转折：这项工作“看上去”是一回事，可是“表面的简单可能掩盖相当大的复杂性”。“apparent simplicity”（表面的简单）重复了空格处的意思。所以在维修手册里，这项工作看上去很简单。空格处的词必须表示“简单”。

approach_en: "Infrequent" means not often met with. Agee says he "had seen nothing but woods, and infrequent woods farms, for a good while". As he drives, mostly woods go by, and only now and then a farm. So the farms are few and far apart.
approach_zh: infrequent 的意思是“不常遇到的”。Agee 说他“好一阵子除了树林，以及偶尔出现的林间农场，什么也没看见”。车一路开过去，见到的大多是树林，只是偶尔才有一座农场。所以这些农场数量很少，彼此相隔很远。

approach_en: "Despite" sets up a surprise: many more advanced tools exist, yet the pipe wrench "remains" something to plumbers. The second sentence says its mix of qualities "has been impossible for toolmakers to match". A tool that nothing can replace is one plumbers cannot do without.
approach_zh: Despite 引出了一个出人意料的事实：更先进的工具已经出现了很多，可管钳对水管工来说“仍然”是某种东西。第二句说它那几种品质的结合“工具制造商始终无法比得上”。一件无可替代的工具，就是水管工离不开的工具。

approach_en: The second sentence, built on "whereas", describes two different patterns: in active regions bursts of light come before drops in magnetic energy; in quiet regions the two stay linked with no such drops. The two kinds of region behave differently. The missing word must mean "difference".
approach_zh: 第二句以 whereas 为轴，描述了两种不同的模式：在活动区，紫外光爆发出现在磁能下降之前；在宁静区，两者一直保持关联，没有这样的下降。两类区域的表现不同。空格处的词必须表示“差异”。

approach_en: The passage has two parts. Sentences 1 to 3 say what constellations are and how they get their names. Sentences 4 to 7 give two examples of naming: Orion (a hunter) and Ursa Major (a bear).
approach_zh: 文章分两部分。第1到3句说明了什么是星座，以及星座是怎样得名的。第4到7句举了两个命名的例子：猎户座（猎人）和大熊座（熊）。

approach_en: List what the passage covers about the moon jar: when it became well known, its shape, how it is finished, and how potters today still make it. That is a short general account of one kind of traditional pottery.
approach_zh: 列一列文章讲了月亮罐的哪些方面：什么时候开始出名、形状如何、表面怎样处理、今天的陶艺家还在怎样制作它。这是对一种传统陶器的简要概述。

approach_en: Before the underlined line, Sneerwell excuses Sir Benjamin because he is a wit, and Maria disagrees: wit joined with malice loses her respect. Maria then asks Surface what he thinks. His answer, the underlined line, condemns laughing at a cruel joke. That sides with Maria and goes against Sneerwell.
approach_zh: 在画线句之前，Sneerwell 以 Sir Benjamin 是才子为由替他开脱，Maria 表示不同意：才智与恶意结伴，她就不再尊重。接着 Maria 问 Surface 怎么看。他的回答（画线句）谴责了对着伤人的玩笑发笑的行为，这是站在 Maria 一边，反对 Sneerwell。

approach_en: Ask what every sentence is about. Sentence 1 defines division of labor, sentences 2 and 3 show how it works, and sentences 4 and 5 give its results: more skill, less lost time, more goods. The topic is how this system makes production more efficient.
approach_zh: 看每一句都在讲什么。第1句给劳动分工下定义，第2、3句说明它怎样运作，第4、5句给出结果：更熟练、更省时间、产量更高。主题是这种制度如何提高生产效率。

approach_en: The passage is built on a contrast marked by "however". Plants pollinated by hummingbirds attract them with bright colors. Hammer orchids "use a different strategy": they trick ("deceiving") a wasp into pollinating them. The main idea must include both the contrast and the deception.
approach_zh: 文章建立在 however 标出的对比之上。靠蜂鸟传粉的植物用鲜艳的颜色吸引蜂鸟；槌兰（hammer orchids）则“采用不同的策略”：通过欺骗（deceiving）黄蜂来完成传粉。主旨必须既包含这个对比，又包含“欺骗”这一点。

approach_en: The first sentence of the story text says the Mole now sees the dreadful wood "in quite a changed aspect". The next sentence explains why: the snow is hiding the holes, pitfalls and other dangers under "a gleaming carpet". The main idea joins the change to its cause.
approach_zh: 故事正文的第一句说，这片曾经可怕的树林在鼹鼠眼里“完全变了样”。下一句解释了原因：雪正把坑洞、陷阱等危险盖在“一条闪闪发亮的地毯”下面。主旨要把这个变化和它的原因连起来。

approach_en: The claim is that the speaker "encourages readers to persevere through difficulty". The right quotation must speak to the reader and urge them to keep going. A line that only describes difficulty is not encouragement.
approach_zh: 这个说法是：诗中的说话者“鼓励读者在困难中坚持下去”。正确的引文必须是对读者说话，并且敦促他们继续前行。只描写困难的诗句算不上鼓励。

approach_en: The student's point needs two countries: one with a very large population but low density, and one with a much smaller population but higher density. In the table, Mali has 17,600,000 people and a density of 14.2, while Comoros has 788,000 people and a density of 363.1. That pair fits.
approach_zh: 学生的观点需要用两个国家来说明：一个人口很多但密度低，另一个人口少得多但密度高。表中马里有17,600,000人，密度为14.2；科摩罗有788,000人，密度为363.1。这一对正好符合。

approach_en: The mark at the end of Riddle 68 normally means "a riddle ends here". Scholars who call the mark a copying mistake ("scribal error") are saying that Riddle 68 does not really end there: it and Riddle 69 are one riddle. Support would be evidence that the two belong together.
approach_zh: Riddle 68 末尾的那个记号通常表示“一则谜语到此结束”。认为这个记号是抄写错误（scribal error）的学者，实际上是在说 Riddle 68 并没有在那里结束，它和 Riddle 69 其实是同一则谜语。能支持这种看法的，是两者本属一体的证据。

approach_en: The sentence with the blank admits a limit: the results "are limited in what they can tell us". Look at how the test was done: "data from a single day in the state of Oklahoma". One day in one place is a very small sample.
approach_zh: 空格所在的句子承认了局限：这些结果“能说明的问题有限”。看看测试是怎么做的：用的是“俄克拉荷马州某一天的数据”。一个地方、一天，样本非常小。

approach_en: The musicians had far more noise exposure and chose louder volumes, so one might guess that their hearing was damaged and they needed more volume. "However" removes that guess: the two groups had "clinically comparable hearing". So the difference in volume does not come from hearing loss caused by noise.
approach_zh: 音乐人接触噪声多得多，选择的音量也更大，人们可能会猜想他们的听力受损了，所以需要更大的音量。However 否定了这种猜想：两组人的听力“在临床上相当”。所以，音量上的差异并不是噪声造成的听力损失引起的。

approach_en: The clause "when it was introduced in 1909" fixes the time in the past. The reaction of the public happened at that same past time, so the verb is the simple past.
approach_zh: 从句“when it was introduced in 1909”把时间定在了过去。公众的反应发生在同一个过去的时间，所以用一般过去时。

approach_en: Decide each word in turn. Bhutan is one country, and the residents belong to it: "country's". The residents themselves own nothing in this sentence, so "residents" is a plain plural. Then a comma sets off the example that begins with "including".
approach_zh: 逐个词判断。不丹是一个国家，居民属于这个国家，用 country's。居民在这句话里并不拥有什么，所以 residents 是普通的复数。后面用逗号把 including 引出的例子隔开。

approach_en: The sentence up to "writing" is complete: Madrid revealed her favorite book about the craft of writing. What follows is simply the title of that book. A colon introduces the thing just described.
approach_zh: 到 writing 为止句子已经完整：Madrid 透露了她最喜欢的一本谈写作技艺的书。后面只是这本书的书名，用冒号引出前面所说的那样东西即可。

approach_en: Three scholars are listed, and each name is followed by a comma and a job description ("Jeff Todd Titon, a professor at Brown University"). Because every item contains a comma, semicolons must separate the items, and each name needs its comma.
approach_zh: 句子列举了三位学者，每个姓名后面都用逗号带出职务说明（如“Jeff Todd Titon, a professor at Brown University”）。因为每一项内部都有逗号，项与项之间要用分号，每个姓名后面的逗号也不能少。

approach_en: The subject is "medieval recreation", singular. The list between the dashes ("including chess, backgammon, and other board games ...") gives examples and does not change the subject. The passage is about the past, so a singular past verb is needed.
approach_zh: 主语是“medieval recreation”，单数。破折号之间的列举（“including chess, backgammon, and other board games ...”）只是举例，不改变主语。文章讲的是过去，所以需要单数的过去时动词。

approach_en: The second sentence names a place: a pavilion for birdwatching in Taiwan. The third describes how the sculpture looks at that place: like red bamboo columns holding up the pavilion. The transition should point back to the place: "there".
approach_zh: 第二句提到了一个地点：台湾的一座观鸟亭。第三句描述的是这件雕塑在那个地点的样子：看上去像是支撑着亭子的一组红色竹柱。过渡词应当指回这个地点：there（在那里）。

approach_en: Two times of day are described in order. "Early in the morning", when it is cool, the lizard sits in the sun. "As the temperature rises", it hides in the shade. The second time comes after the first, so the transition is "later".
approach_zh: 文章按先后描述了一天中的两个时段。“清晨”气温还低，蜥蜴待在有阳光的地方；“随着气温升高”，它躲进阴凉处。后一个时段在前一个之后，所以过渡词用 later。

approach_en: The second sentence gives one achievement: in 1916 Guardipee founded the first all-Native Boy Scout troop. The third gives another: in 1932 he became one of the first Native park rangers at Glacier National Park. The third sentence adds a second achievement.
approach_zh: 第二句讲了一项成就：1916年 Guardipee 创办了第一支全部由原住民组成的童子军队伍。第三句讲了另一项成就：1932年他成为冰川国家公园最早的原住民护林员之一。第三句是在补充第二项成就。

approach_en: Compare what drought does to the leaves of two plants. Avocado plants grow smaller leaves. Sugarcane leaves grow slightly longer. The two reactions go in opposite directions, so the transition must mark contrast.
approach_zh: 比较干旱对两种植物叶片的影响。牛油果植株长出更小的叶子；甘蔗的叶片则略微变长。两种反应方向相反，所以过渡词必须表示对比。

approach_en: The goal is to stress how much bigger the Sun is than Earth. The last note says it outright: "The Sun is over 100 times bigger than Earth." The right choice must make that comparison between the real Sun and the real Earth.
approach_zh: 目标是强调太阳比地球大多少。最后一条笔记说得很明白：“太阳比地球大100倍以上。”正确选项必须把真实的太阳和真实的地球作这样的比较。

approach_en: The goal is a similarity between the two plants. They harm ecosystems in somewhat different ways and came to the US in different ways. What they share is the first note's point: each is a nonnative species that causes harm, so each is "considered invasive".
approach_zh: 目标是两种植物的一个相似之处。它们危害生态系统的方式不尽相同，传入美国的途径也不同。共同点在于第一条笔记所说的：两者都是造成危害的外来物种，所以都“被视为入侵物种”。

approach_en: The goal is a specific example of a type of urban natural area. The notes name one type: ruderal areas, defined as "vacant lots that are overrun with wild vegetation". The right choice must name that type.
approach_zh: 目标是举出一类城市自然区域的具体例子。笔记里提到了其中一类：荒地植被区（ruderal areas），定义是“长满野生植被的空地”。正确选项必须说出这一类。

approach_en: The third sentence describes the management the second sentence calls for: "careful consideration" of several factors, then "precise, minute adjustments". Work that is careful and exact down to small details is described by the missing word.
approach_zh: 第三句描述了第二句所要求的那种管理：对几方面因素作“仔细的考虑”，然后作“精确、细微的调整”。连细节都做得仔细而精确，就是空格处的词所形容的。

approach_en: "However" introduces what stopped the reviewers from reaching one conclusion. The 51 studies were not alike: they used different methods and measured different health effects. Large differences among things that are being compared are what the missing word names.
approach_zh: However 引出了妨碍综述者得出统一结论的因素。这51项研究各不相同：采用的方法不一样，测量的健康效果也不一样。被拿来比较的对象之间存在很大的差别，这就是空格处的词所指的。

approach_en: The third sentence gives examples that explain the blank ("for example"). Different kinds of microhistory arose at different times in different countries; work of the 1980s reflected that period's interests; a recent change in the field produced a new wave. In each case the questions depended on the historian's time and place. The missing words must say that.
approach_zh: 第三句举例解释了空格处的内容（for example）。不同流派的微观史在不同的时间出现于不同的国家；20世纪80年代的作品反映了那个时期的兴趣；这个领域近来的一次转向又催生了新的一批作品。每一种情况下，提出什么问题都取决于历史学家所处的时代和环境。空格处的词语必须表达这个意思。

approach_en: The second sentence explains the blank. Animals that carry seeds gather at different distances, hold seeds for different lengths of time and move along paths of their own. Seeds therefore land in irregular places, so trees of one species grow in separate patches with gaps between. A distribution with breaks in it is described by the missing word.
approach_zh: 第二句解释了空格处的词。传播种子的动物聚集的距离各不相同，携带种子的时间长短不一，移动的路线也各有特点。因此种子落在不规则的地方，同一种树就长成一片一片互不相连的斑块，中间留有空隙。有间断的分布，就是空格处的词所形容的。

approach_en: The underlined part brings in an expert, Horace Newcomb, who notes that tools taken from film studies "often proved inadequate" for television. The next sentence says "a recognition of the limitations led researchers to" new approaches. So Newcomb's observation gives the reason scholars changed their methods.
approach_zh: 画线部分引入了一位专家 Horace Newcomb 的看法：从电影研究借来的工具用在电视上“往往不够用”。下一句说“对这些局限的认识促使研究者转向了”新的方法。所以 Newcomb 的观察说明了学者们改变研究方法的原因。

approach_en: The underlined part states the film's central idea: "the camera itself is a character in the film". The next sentence describes what the director does: he keeps drawing attention to the camera by showing the operator placing it. The idea explains the choices. A central imaginative idea of a work is called a "conceit".
approach_zh: 画线部分说出了这部影片的核心构思：“摄影机本身就是片中的一个角色”。下一句描述了导演的做法：他不断展示摄影师摆放摄影机的过程，以此突出摄影机的存在。这个构思解释了这些做法。一部作品的核心巧思，英语里叫 conceit。

approach_en: Slater and Mann (Text 1) say females sing as often as males in the tropics but, by implication, not in temperate regions. Rose (Text 2) says female song in temperate species is more common than assumed, and that it goes unnoticed because the females sing less often and more quietly. So Rose would say the difference is partly a matter of what researchers manage to notice.
approach_zh: Slater 和 Mann（文本1）说，在热带，雌鸟鸣唱和雄鸟一样频繁，言下之意是温带并非如此。Rose（文本2）则说，温带鸟类中雌鸟鸣唱比人们以为的更常见，只是因为雌鸟唱得少、声音也不那么响亮，所以没有被注意到。因此 Rose 会认为，这种差异部分是研究者能不能察觉到的问题。

approach_en: Salman-Engin (Text 1) points out that research has usually looked at people we already know, and shows that contact with strangers also makes people feel good. The model in Text 2 has three circles, and even the outermost holds only people "counted as part of one's social network". Strangers appear nowhere in it. So she would see the model as a sign that research leaves out a kind of contact that matters.
approach_zh: Salman-Engin（文本1）指出，以往的研究通常只关注已经认识的人，而她的研究表明与陌生人的接触同样让人感觉更好。文本2的模型有三个圈，连最外面的一圈装的也只是“算得上自己社交网络一部分”的人，陌生人根本不在其中。所以她会认为，这个模型说明研究遗漏了一类重要的交往。

approach_en: The question asks which factors were linked to behavior. The second sentence reports two findings: white butterflies were seen on green flowers more than others (color), and butterflies fed more on cloudy days (weather). Both factors are linked.
approach_zh: 题目问的是哪些因素与行为有关。第二句报告了两项发现：白色蝴蝶比其他蝴蝶更常出现在绿色的花上（颜色），蝴蝶在阴天进食更频繁（天气）。两个因素都有关联。

approach_en: The hypothesis compares two ways of using an emoji. The usual negative effect appears when the emoji is added after the text (supplement). The team predicts the effect is smaller when the emoji replaces the word (substitute). The supporting data must therefore compare substitute with supplement. The graph gives about 3.6 for supplement, 4.1 for substitute and 4.2 for control.
approach_zh: 这个假说比较的是使用表情符号的两种方式。表情符号加在文字后面（supplement）时会出现通常的负面效应；研究团队预测，用表情符号替换文字（substitute）时这种效应会减弱。所以支持假说的数据必须是 substitute 与 supplement 的比较。图中三组的平均分大约是：supplement 3.6，substitute 4.1，control 4.2。

approach_en: The employee's conclusion is a comparison: modular construction is more efficient than other methods. To support a comparison you need data on both sides. Every building in the table was built with modular methods, so the table has nothing to compare them with.
approach_zh: 这位员工的结论是一个比较：模块化建造比其他建造方式效率更高。要支持一个比较，两边的数据都得有。而表中的每一座建筑都是用模块化方式建造的，表里没有可以拿来对比的对象。

approach_en: The sentence before the blank says that in most countries green hydrogen "would require a larger share" of on-site electricity in 2050 than in 2020. "One exception" must be a place where the share does not grow. Compare the two percentage columns: Indonesia 51 to 63, the Netherlands 79 to 79, South Africa 9 to 30, Taiwan 1 to 17. Only the Netherlands stays the same.
approach_zh: 空格前一句说，在大多数国家，到2050年生产绿氢“将需要占用更大比例”的就地发电量。“一个例外”必须是这个比例没有增长的地方。比较两个百分比栏：印度尼西亚从51到63，荷兰从79到79，南非从9到30，台湾从1到17。只有荷兰保持不变。

approach_en: Two explanations are offered: warmth ("warmer together") and safety from predators ("safer together"). The study tests both. Temperature "was not associated with size", so warmth gets no support. A predator's presence went with bigger and longer murmurations, so safety is supported.
approach_zh: 文中给出了两种解释：取暖（“warmer together”）和防御捕食者（“safer together”）。这项研究对两者都作了检验。气温“与规模无关”，所以取暖说没有得到支持；有捕食者在场时，集群的规模更大、持续时间更长，所以安全说得到了支持。

approach_en: There is a gap of 6.5 million years in the Arabian fossil record. During that same time, animals were clearly moving between Africa and Eurasia, and for grassland species the Arabian Peninsula was the only possible route. So animals must have been on the Peninsula during the gap. If they were there but left no known fossils, the gap comes from poor preservation, too little searching, or both.
approach_zh: 阿拉伯半岛的化石记录中有一段长达650万年的空白。而在同一时期，动物显然在非洲和欧亚大陆之间往来迁移；对于适应草原的物种来说，阿拉伯半岛是唯一可行的通道。所以在这段空白期里，半岛上一定有动物。它们在那里生活过却没有留下已知的化石，那么这段空白就是保存条件差、发掘不够，或者两者兼有造成的。

approach_en: The underlined sentence is the last one: when cells last a shorter time, the cost gap between plants using new cells and plants using recycled cells grows from 18.8% to 31.3%. A shorter lifetime means cells are replaced more often. The gap grows only if each replacement costs more for new cells than for recycled ones, and the cost named in the passage that differs between them is the cost of getting materials.
approach_zh: 画线句是最后一句：电池寿命缩短后，使用新电池的电站与使用回收电池的电站之间的成本差距，从18.8%扩大到31.3%。寿命缩短意味着更换更频繁。只有当每次更换时新电池比回收电池花费更多，差距才会拉大；而文中提到的、两者有差别的成本正是获取材料的费用。

approach_en: The blank sits inside a phrase that begins with "with": "with executives rather than creatives ... decision-making power". After "with + noun", English uses an "-ing" form, not a full verb: "with executives ... being given ... power".
approach_zh: 空格位于 with 引出的短语里：“with executives rather than creatives ... decision-making power”。在“with + 名词”之后，英语用动词的 -ing 形式，而不用完整的谓语动词：“with executives ... being given ... power”。

approach_en: Find the main verb of the second sentence: "Scholars ... posited that Confucianism's emphasis ...". Since "posited" is the main verb, the blank needs an "-ing" form that describes the scholars: "Scholars considering cultural explanations".
approach_zh: 先找第二句的谓语：“Scholars ... posited that Confucianism's emphasis ...”。既然 posited 已经是谓语，空格处就需要一个修饰 scholars 的 -ing 形式：“Scholars considering cultural explanations”（考虑文化解释的学者）。

approach_en: "Noise from human activity poses significant challenges to animal populations" is a complete sentence. The next part, with its "for example", is another complete sentence that illustrates the first. A colon joins a statement to its example.
approach_zh: “Noise from human activity poses significant challenges to animal populations”是完整的句子；后面带有 for example 的部分也是完整的句子，是对前一句的举例说明。冒号可以连接一个说法和说明它的例子。

approach_en: The words before the blank ("While ..., the frogfish's unique locomotion represents a specialized adaptation for movement along the ocean floor") make a complete sentence. The words after it are another complete sentence that explains the adaptation. Use a colon.
approach_zh: 空格之前“While ..., the frogfish's unique locomotion represents a specialized adaptation for movement along the ocean floor”是完整的句子，空格之后是另一个完整的句子，解释了这种适应的具体情况，所以用冒号。

approach_en: Look inside the clause that begins "whose work". Its verb comes much later: "whose work ... encourages a broader rethinking". Since "encourages" is the verb of that clause, the blank needs an "-ing" form describing "work": "work highlighting the richness of Robinson's poems".
approach_zh: 看“whose work”引导的这个从句。它的谓语出现在很后面：“whose work ... encourages a broader rethinking”。既然 encourages 是这个从句的谓语，空格处就需要一个修饰 work 的 -ing 形式：“work highlighting the richness of Robinson's poems”（凸显 Robinson 诗作之丰富的研究）。

approach_en: The subject is "each", not "samples". "Each of the instrumental samples" means every single one, so the verb is singular. The part between the dashes only describes the samples.
approach_zh: 主语是 each，不是 samples。“each of the instrumental samples”指其中的每一个，所以谓语用单数。破折号之间的部分只是在描述这些采样。

approach_en: The first sentence says where the sculpture stands: Storm King Art Center, an outdoor sculpture park. The second says what it meets: rain, snow, heat and humidity. These come with the place, so the transition should simply point back to it: "there".
approach_zh: 第一句说明了这件雕塑的位置：Storm King 艺术中心，一座户外雕塑公园。第二句说的是它在那里经受的东西：雨、雪、高温和潮湿。这些都是这个地点带来的，所以过渡词只需指回这个地点：there（在那里）。

approach_en: The second sentence states a goal: the researchers "wanted to determine whether" the wear on the tray pieces fits the baking of doughs containing fat. The third describes what they did to reach that goal: an experiment with copies of the trays. A goal followed by the action taken to reach it calls for "to that end".
approach_zh: 第二句陈述了一个目标：研究者“想确定”托盘碎片上的磨损痕迹是否与烘烤含油脂的面团相符。第三句描述了他们为达到这个目标所做的事：用托盘的复制品做实验。先讲目标、再讲为此采取的行动，要用“to that end”。

approach_en: The first sentence gives Putnam's argument: social ties have weakened because fewer people join organized groups. The words after the blank give figures about bowling: more bowlers, but far fewer in leagues. That is a case of the trend, and it is where the title Bowling Alone comes from. The missing words must present it as such.
approach_zh: 第一句给出了 Putnam 的论点：社会联系减弱，是因为参加有组织团体的人减少了。空格之后给出了关于保龄球的数字：打保龄球的人多了，参加联赛的人却少了很多。这是那个趋势的一个实例，也是书名《独自打保龄》（Bowling Alone）的由来。空格处的内容必须把它作为这样的例子引出来。

approach_en: The first sentence names a finding in general terms: "a distinct time-pressure effect" on molting. The second sentence says exactly what that effect was: birds that seemed to have less time molted faster and grew shorter wing feathers. Saying the same thing again more exactly calls for "that is".
approach_zh: 第一句用概括的说法提到一项发现：换羽行为存在“明显的时间压力效应”。第二句具体说明了这个效应是什么：显得时间更紧的鸟换羽更快，长出的翼羽更短。把同一件事更确切地再说一遍，要用“that is”（也就是说）。

approach_en: The first sentence gives a fact: two schools of the same period give "distinctly different answers" to basic questions. The second states what this confirms: the "contemporary period" is a time of wide debate, not of agreement. A sentence that confirms and strengthens what the previous one shows takes "indeed".
approach_zh: 第一句给出一个事实：同属一个时期的两个学派，对基本问题给出了“截然不同的回答”。第二句说的是这一事实所印证的看法：“当代时期”是一个众说纷纭的时期，而不是一个意见一致的时期。对上一句所体现的意思加以确认和强调，过渡词用 indeed。

approach_en: The goal has two requirements: cite the historian (Valosik), and explain why Digby wrote the manual. Valosik's words give the reason: "Digby hoped to revive swimming ... and elevate it from a crude, mechanical function ... to an artful science". The right choice must credit Valosik and keep her meaning.
approach_zh: 目标有两个要求：引用历史学家（Valosik）的话，并解释 Digby 为什么写这本手册。Valosik 的话给出了原因：“Digby 希望复兴游泳……并把它从手脚粗糙、机械的动作提升为一门精巧的学问”。正确选项必须注明这是 Valosik 的说法，并且不改变她的意思。

approach_en: The first sentence gives one achievement of the play: it gave English the word "robot". The second gives another: it "also contributed" to an old literary tradition. The word "also" shows that the second point goes further than the first, so the transition must mean "more than just inventing a word".
approach_zh: 第一句讲了这部戏的一项成就：它给英语带来了 robot 这个词。第二句讲了另一项成就：它“还为”一个古老的文学传统“作出了贡献”。also 表明第二点比第一点更进一步，所以过渡语的意思必须是“不只是创造了一个词”。

approach_en: Look at "a material that, because of its malleability, could be easily carved". The phrase "because of its malleability" interrupts between "that" and "could be carved". An interrupting phrase needs the same mark on both sides. It opens with a comma after "that", so it must close with a comma.
approach_zh: 看“a material that, because of its malleability, could be easily carved”这一部分。“because of its malleability”插在 that 和 could be carved 之间。插入成分前后要用相同的标点：它的前面（that 之后）用的是逗号，后面也必须用逗号。
